### [308] [Migration Flows: Population Scaling and Heavy Tails](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00192)
*Cook Hyun Kim,Sangjoon Park,Seoyoung Jin,Jaiyong Lee*

Main category: cond-mat.stat-mech

TL;DR: 该文用县际迁移解释城际平均流的种群标度与重尾净流分布。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 城际平均流量随城市人口的标度关系以及城际净流分布的重尾特征需要统一机制解释，作者提出县际迁移是关键底层过程。

Method: 假设县对净流服从高斯分布，标准差正比于其方向平均流；出发与到达活动依赖密度，决定平均流随起点和终点城市人口的标度；在固定县对净流相关性下对县对求和得高斯分布；再对相关性分布求条件高斯密度的平均，并用随机模型生成该混合中的方差分布。

Result: 对条件高斯密度按相关性分布平均后，可产生带高斯截断的中间幂律，从而同时复现平均城际流的种群标度和净流分布的重尾。

Conclusion: 县际迁移结合密度依赖的出发/到达活动与相关性混合机制，可统一解释城际流的标度律和重尾净流统计。

Abstract: We show how migration between counties in different cities can explain both the population scaling of mean intercity flows and heavy-tailed intercity net-flow distributions. Density-dependent departure and arrival activities determine how mean flows scale with the populations of the origin and destination cities. We assume Gaussian county-pair net flows with standard deviations proportional to their mean directional flows. At a fixed correlation between county-pair net flows, their sum is Gaussian. Averaging this conditional Gaussian density over the correlation distribution can produce an intermediate power law with a Gaussian cutoff. We also present a stochastic model that generates the variance distribution used in this mixture.

</details>


### [309] [Active-Matter Battery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00428)
*Yun-Qian Lin,Rui-Han Liu,Yu-Han Ma*

Main category: cond-mat.stat-mech

TL;DR: 本文提出一个从活性物质中提取并储存能量的最小电池模型，解析推导了其充放电特性；当计入维持活性的能量成本后，充电功率—效率权衡呈现回线形，效率存在有限时间极大值，与被动能量器件截然不同。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 利用活性物质（active matter）驱动机能器件日益受到关注，但缺乏描述"从活性物质中储能"这一过程的基础理论模型，尤其是充电功率与效率之间关系的定量刻画。

Method: 构建一个最小化的活性物质电池模型，解析求解其充电与放电特性；并在能量收支中显式引入维持活性所需的能量成本。

Result: 充电功率—效率的权衡关系由通常的单调曲线变为回线（loop-like）形状；效率在有限时间内出现极大值，而非被动器件中单调趋近无穷慢充电下的上限。

Conclusion: 活性物质的能量成本从根本上改变了储能器件的性能权衡，为设计活性物质驱动的功能器件提供了理论依据与新的优化原则。

Abstract: Harnessing active matter to power functional devices has attracted growing interest. We propose a minimal battery model for storing energy extracted from active matter and derive its charging and discharging characteristics analytically. When the energetic cost of sustaining activity is included, the charging power-efficiency trade-off becomes loop-like and the efficiency attains a finite-time maximum, in sharp contrast to passive energy devices.

</details>


### [310] [Generative Modeling of Stochastic Dynamics for Long-Time Evolution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00546)
*Yang-yang Tan,Jinyang Li,Lingxiao Wang*

Main category: cond-mat.stat-mech

TL;DR: 短时构型对训练生成式扩散模型学习有限时间转移核，迭代后可长时外推非平衡动力学，无需运动方程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非平衡动力学的精确随机方程通常难以获得，需要一种不依赖运动方程、仅凭短时观测即可预测长时演化的方法。

Method: 用固定短时间间隔的构型对训练生成式扩散模型，学习有限时间转移核；通过迭代该核将动力学传播到远超训练时滞的时间尺度。在二维Model B（守恒序参量的扩散动力学）和周期光势中驱动胶体两个体系上验证。

Result: 二维Model B中，学习到的核重现了动态临界标度和自相似t^{1/3}粗化；在最大训练尺寸两倍的格点上及未参与训练的初始系综上仍与直接模拟一致。驱动胶体中，十分钟轨迹即可在实验不确定度内预测随后二十分钟的粒子流与平均通过时间。

Conclusion: 短时观测已包含预测远长时涌现非平衡动力学所需的信息。

Abstract: Exact stochastic equations for non-equilibrium dynamics are rarely accessible. We show that the long-time evolution of stochastic dynamics can be predicted from configuration pairs at a fixed short time lag, without knowledge of the equation of motion. Generative diffusion models learn the finite-time transition kernel from these pairs, and iterating it propagates the dynamics far beyond the training lag. For two-dimensional Model B, the diffusive dynamics of a conserved order parameter, the learned kernels reproduce dynamic critical scaling and self-similar $t^{1/3}$ coarsening. Agreement with direct simulations persists on lattices twice the largest training size and for initial ensembles absent from training. For driven colloids in a periodic optical potential, ten minutes of measured trajectories suffice to predict the particle current and mean passage time over the next twenty minutes within experimental uncertainty. Short-time observations thus contain the information needed to predict emergent non-equilibrium dynamics at much longer times.

</details>


### [311] [The Ericson Transition in Time-Reversal Invariant Systems: Symplectically Invariant Hamiltonians](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00624)
*Simon Köhnes,Thomas Guhr*

Main category: cond-mat.stat-mech

TL;DR: 在时间反演不变且自旋为奇数的系统中，利用Heidelberg普适方法证明Ericson区非对角散射矩阵元及其截面分布的主导项为高斯与指数行为，并推导次主导项，与数值模拟对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究时间反演不变、自旋为奇数的量子系统在Ericson区的散射统计分布，检验普适性预测的渐近行为。

Method: 采用普适Heidelberg方法（随机矩阵理论与散射矩阵统计），对非对角散射矩阵元及截面的分布做渐近展开，求主导项与次主导项，并进行数值模拟验证。

Result: 证明主导项分别为高斯分布（散射矩阵元）与指数分布（截面）；给出次主导项解析表达式，并与数值模拟结果相符。

Conclusion: 证实了该类系统中散射统计的普适性，次主导修正可被显式导出且获得数值支持，可用于表征Ericson涨落的有限尺寸效应。

Abstract: We investigate the distributions of off-diagonal scattering matrix elements and cross-sections in the Ericson regime for time-reversal invariant systems with odd spin. Within the universal Heidelberg approach we prove that Gaussian and exponential behavior is found as the leading-order term of an asymptotic expansion of the aforementioned distributions. Furthermore, the subleading-order term is derived and compared with numerical simulations.

</details>


### [312] [CTMRG as a tensor-network message-passing algorithm](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00631)
*Illia Lukin,Andrii Sotnikov*

Main category: cond-mat.stat-mech

TL;DR: 该文将角转移矩阵方程及基于其的角转移矩阵重整化群（CTMRG）形式化为一般平面图上的局域方程组，这些方程仅依赖平面图的局域子图并一致粘合以描述整图；求解可得消息张量与角矩阵，进而为任意连通子图构造MPS环境。作者在铁磁Ising模型、多种无限晶格（含双曲晶格）及有限图上测试，发现相对信念传播（belief propagation）有系统性改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 角转移矩阵方法与CTMRG通常针对特定规则晶格（如正方形格子）构造，缺乏对一般平面图的通用、局域化表述，限制了其在非规则或复杂拓扑（如双曲晶格、有限图）上的应用；同时需要一种能超越信念传播精度的通用张量网络收缩/环境构造方法。

Method: 将角转移矩阵方程与CTMRG重新表述为定义在一般平面图上的局域方程：方程仅依赖每个局部子图，并通过一致粘合（gluing）覆盖整图；求解该方程组得到消息张量（message tensors）与角矩阵（corner matrices），据此可为任意连通子图构造矩阵乘积态（MPS）环境。随后在铁磁Ising模型、多种无限晶格（含双曲晶格）及有限图上进行数值验证，并与信念传播对比。

Result: 在铁磁Ising模型、多种无限晶格（包括双曲晶格）和有限图上的测试表明，所提出的局域CTMRG方程能够一致求解并构造MPS环境，且相比信念传播呈现系统性精度改进。

Conclusion: 该工作给出了一般平面图上角转移矩阵方程与CTMRG的局域、可粘合表述，统一并推广了传统CTMRG，为任意平面图及连通子图提供MPS环境构造工具，并在多类晶格与有限图上验证了其优于信念传播的系统性提升。

Abstract: We formulate the corner transfer matrix equations, and the corner transfer matrix renormalization group built on them, as a set of local equations on general planar graphs. These equations depend only on the local subgraphs of the planar graph and are glued together consistently to describe the whole graph. Solving them yields message tensors and corner matrices, which can be used to construct an MPS environment for any connected subgraph. We test the proposed equations on the ferromagnetic Ising model, on a variety of infinite lattices (including hyperbolic ones) and on finite graphs, and find systematic improvement over belief propagation.

</details>


### [313] [Thermal entanglement transitions from strong $\textrm{SU}(2)$ symmetry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00826)
*Siqi Mo,Ehud Altman,Samuel J. Garratt*

Main category: cond-mat.stat-mech

TL;DR: 本文研究具有强SU(2)对称性的Gibbs态中的混合态纠缠，证明有限温度有序相变伴随纠缠相变，并给出铁磁相中纠缠度量随系统尺寸增长更快的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究强对称Lindbladian稳态中是否存在纠缠相变，并理解混合态纠缠度量（可蒸馏纠缠、对数纠缠负度）在铁磁相与顺磁相中随系统尺寸的标度行为。

Method: 首先建立SU(2)单态下混合态纠缠度量与自旋关联的关系；提出SU(2)单态热态的半经典理论，在大S极限下将全局单态约束简化为总磁化的高斯抑制；导出描述单态扇区自旋关联的场论；结合三维晶格蒙特卡洛模拟与一维自旋-1/2精确数值方法验证。

Result: 顺磁相中可蒸馏纠缠与对数纠缠负度随自旋数平方根对数增长；铁磁相中这些量随系统尺寸呈参数化更快增长；半经典场论确定低温与高温下混合态纠缠探针的行为，数值模拟支持解析结论，一维精确数值证实顺磁相中纠缠随关联长度与系统尺寸的标度预测。

Conclusion: 有限温度有序相变与纠缠相变相关联，强对称Lindbladian稳态可表现出纠缠相变；所提出的单态半经典理论与场论框架能够刻画混合态纠缠在铁磁与顺磁相中的标度行为。

Abstract: We study mixed-state entanglement in Gibbs states with strong $\mathrm{SU}(2)$ symmetry, focusing on locally interacting spin systems with ferromagnetic interactions. Our main result is to show that finite-temperature ordering transitions are associated with entanglement transitions, and therefore the steady state of strongly symmetric Lindbladians can exhibit entanglement transitions. While in the paramagnetic phase it is known that the distillable entanglement and logarithmic entanglement negativity between two halves of a large system grow logarithmically with the square root of the number of spins, we show that in ferromagnetic phases these quantities grow parametrically faster with system size. To arrive at this result we first establish relations between these mixed-state entanglement measures and spin correlations in states that are singlets under global $\rm{SU}(2)$ symmetry transformations. We then introduce a semiclassical theory for $\rm{SU}(2)$ singlet thermal states. While the global singlet constraint generally enters this theory as a complicated function of the full semiclassical spin configuration, we show that in large $S$ limit it simplifies drastically to a Gaussian suppression of total magnetization in disordered phases as well as in ordered phases in the vicinity of continuous thermal phase transitions. This leads us to a field theory describing spin correlations in the singlet sector. Using this we determine the behavior of various probes of mixed-state entanglement at low and at high temperatures, supporting our analytical results using numerical Monte Carlo simulations of a three-dimensional lattice realization of our semiclassical theory. We also use exact numerics in one-dimensional spin-$1/2$ systems to confirm our predictions for the scaling of mixed-state entanglement with correlation length and system size in the paramagnetic phase.

</details>


### [314] [Effects of on-site Gaussian disorder in the ferromagnetic Blume Capel model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01090)
*Kimberly J. Silverman,Daria Lhommedieu,Alykhan Rajan,Kathryn A. Cooper,Richard T. Scalettar,Eduardo Ibarra-García-Padilla*

Main category: cond-mat.stat-mech

TL;DR: 本文通过蒙特卡洛模拟研究了晶场随机分布（高斯型位点依赖D_i）对Blume-Capel模型相变的影响，发现无序降低二级相变温度并消除一级相变和三临界点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统Blume-Capel模型中晶场D是均匀的，但真实材料中局部空位密度受控的晶场往往存在空间随机性。作者希望了解位点依赖的高斯分布无序如何改变模型的相图，特别是二级相变线和三临界点。

Method: 采用马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC）方法，在固定平均晶场\bar{D}下，计算随高斯分布宽度σ变化的移位相变线T_c；高斯分布形式为P(D_i) ~ exp[-(D_i-\bar{D})^2/2σ^2]。同时对均匀Blume-Capel模型的三临界点受无序影响进行了分析。

Result: 在位点高斯无序作用下，二级相变线T_c随σ增大而降低；结果暗示即使σ很大时T_c仍保持有限。无序还显著抑制一级相变，并在σ较大时将其完全消除，同时影响并最终消除三临界点。

Conclusion: 位点依赖的高斯晶场无序会降低二级相变温度且不使其消失，并显著削弱甚至完全消除一级相变和三临界点，表明无序在Blume-Capel类模型相图中起关键调控作用。

Abstract: We conduct a numerical study of a generalization of the Blume-Capel model in which the crystal field $D_i$, which controls the local vacancy density, is site dependent rather than uniform. We employ Markov Chain Monte Carlo to compute the shifted phase transition line $T_c$ as a function of the width $σ$ of a gaussian distribution $P(D_i) \sim \exp( -(D_i - \bar{D})^2/2 σ^2)$ at fixed $\bar{D}$. We characterize how the presence of this on-site Gaussian disorder reduces $T_c$ across the second order transition line, and discuss how our results suggest that $T_c$ remains finite even at large values of $σ$. We also determine the effects of disorder on the tricritical point of the conventional, uniform, Blume-Capel model, finding that it significantly suppresses the first-order phase transition, eliminating it entirely at large values of $σ$.

</details>


### [315] [Dynamical Critical Properties of the Random-Bond three-state Potts Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01176)
*Zeynep Demir Vatansever,Ulvi Kanbur,Mohammed Sadra Najafi,Muktish Acharyya,Erol Vatansever*

Main category: cond-mat.stat-mech

TL;DR: 采用Wolff与Swendsen-Wang团簇算法对二维随机键三态Potts模型的动态临界行为进行大规模Monte Carlo模拟，发现键无序显著削弱临界慢化，动力学指数z从纯系统的约0.54降至强无序下的约0.24，但静态普适类不变，且静态与动态观测量均表现出缺乏自平均性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究无序（随机键）如何影响二维三态Potts模型的临界动力学，尤其是临界慢化的强弱以及动力学普适性是否改变，是理解淬火无序系统临界行为的重要问题。

Method: 使用Wolff和Swendsen-Wang团簇算法对二维随机键三态Potts模型进行大规模Monte Carlo模拟；在无序依赖的临界温度下计算积分与指数自相关时间，通过有限尺寸标度提取动态临界指数z；并由Wolff团簇尺寸的有限尺寸标度获得γ/ν。

Result: 键无序显著削弱临界慢化，动态指数由纯系统的z≈0.54下降到强无序时的z≈0.24；由Wolff团簇尺寸标度得到γ/ν≈1.73，与二维三态Potts模型的普适类一致；比热与自相关时间等静态和动态观测量均缺乏自平均性。

Conclusion: 键无序强烈影响临界动力学（降低动态临界指数、削弱临界慢化），但不改变潜在的静态普适类；该无序系统同时表现出静态与动态可观测量缺乏自平均性的特征。

Abstract: We study the dynamic critical behavior of the two-dimensional random-bond three-state Potts model using large-scale Monte Carlo simulations with the Wolff and Swendsen--Wang cluster algorithms. At the disorder-dependent critical temperature, we compute integrated and exponential autocorrelation times and extract the dynamic critical exponent $z$ via finite-size scaling. Critical slowing down is significantly weakened by bond randomness, with the dynamic exponent decreasing from $z \approx 0.54$ in the pure system to $z \approx 0.24$ at strong disorder. From the finite-size scaling of the Wolff cluster size, we obtain $γ/ν\approx 1.73$, where $γ$ and $ν$ are the susceptibility and correlation-length exponents, respectively, consistent with the universality class of the two-dimensional three-state Potts model. These results indicate that bond randomness strongly affects the critical dynamics but leaves the underlying static universality class unchanged. Furthermore, both static and dynamic observables, including the specific heat and the autocorrelation times, show a lack of self-averaging.

</details>


### [316] [Work fluctuation speed limit in boundary conformal field theories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01248)
*Shihao Xia,Ahsan Nazir,Harry J. D. Miller*

Main category: cond-mat.stat-mech

TL;DR: 该论文研究了边界共形场论描述的量子临界系统中有限时间驱动的根本极限，推导出基于涨落的速度极限，并给出可完全由普适标度维数表达的最优驱动方案，确立了功精度-时间权衡关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索量子临界系统在有限时间内被外部驱动时的根本速度极限，理解随机功涨落作为快速控制资源的作用，并寻找普适的功精度-时间权衡规律。

Method: 针对有限温度下弱驱动的边界共形场论，分析外部驱动引起的随机功涨落，推导精确且可饱和的涨落型速度极限，并构造达到该极限的最优驱动协议。

Result: 得到精确可饱和的速度极限，其界限与饱和协议完全由普适标度维数表达；结果在Kibble-Zurek区（时间关联强非局域）与线性驱动最优的绝热区之间插值；小标度维数时时间关联增强，驱动方案显著偏离线性协议，优化优势更大。

Conclusion: 研究确立了边界临界控制的普适功精度-时间权衡关系，可应用于量子杂质、分数量子霍尔和超导电路等平台。

Abstract: We explore the fundamental limits on finite-time driving in quantum critical systems described by boundary conformal field theory. We show that stochastic work fluctuations arising from external driving are a resource for speedy control, and derive an exact, saturable fluctuation-based speed limit in weakly driven boundary conformal field theories at finite temperature. The bound and saturating protocol can be expressed entirely in terms of the universal scaling dimension, and the result interpolates between the Kibble--Zurek regime,where temporal correlations are strongly nonlocal, and an adiabatic regime where linear driving becomes optimal. For small scaling dimension, the enhanced temporal correlations produce pronounced departures from linear protocols and a larger optimization advantage. These results establish a universal work precision--time tradeoff for boundary-critical control, applicable to quantum impurity, fractional quantum Hall, and superconducting-circuit platforms.

</details>


### [317] [On thermalization in random free fermions: Statistical origins and energy-dependent ETH structure](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01414)
*Xiao-Kan Guo,Zhiqiang Huang*

Main category: cond-mat.stat-mech

TL;DR: 本文通过随机矩阵分析研究随机自由费米子模型的热化，推导热化函数及其衰减规律，并证明本征态统计的分解定理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究随机自由费米子模型中的热化机制，并将其作为弱本征态热化假设（ETH）型自平均的解析可解实现。

Method: 通过详细随机矩阵分析，计算单粒子可观测量的集合平均与涨落；引入粒子数守恒，研究能量壳本征态统计并证明其分解定理；在受控的本征矢量-本征值关联变形下考察能量依赖。

Result: 推导出热化函数g²(t/τ_λ)，其中τ_λ=ℏ/(2η√N)，证明其|t|⁻³渐近衰减；涨落方差在热力学极限下趋于O(1/N)；能量分辨斜率与ETH谱函数获得能量依赖；涨落尺度与全混沌系统存在定量差异。

Conclusion: 随机自由费米子模型是弱ETH型自平均的解析可解实现，也是可将本征基混沌与谱混沌分离的可控平台。

Abstract: We study the thermalization in the random free fermion model by a detailed random-matrix analysis. By computing the ensemble average and fluctuations of $\operatorname{Tr}(Aρ(t))$ for a single-particle observable $A$, we derive the thermalization function $g^2(t/τ_λ)$ with $τ_λ= \hbar/(2η\sqrt{N})$, prove its $|t|^{-3}$ asymptotic decay, and show that the variance of the fluctuations vanishes as $O(1/N)$ in the thermodynamic limit.Particle number conservation is also incorporated into the model, by which we further study the energy-shell eigenstate statistics and prove a factorization theorem of the eigenstate statistics. We further show that under a controlled eigenvector-eigenvalue correlation deformation, the diagonal energy-resolved slope and the off-diagonal eigenstate thermalization hypothesis spectral function acquire an energy dependence.Finally, we compute the fluctuations of correlation functions and compare the fluctuation scales with those of a fully chaotic system, revealing quantitative differences rooted in the Gaussian nature of the eigenstates.Our work establishes the random free fermion model as an analytically solvable realization of weak eigenstate thermalization hypothesis type self-averaging, and as a controllable setting in which eigenbasis chaos can be separated from spectral chaos.

</details>


### [318] [Learning ab initio phase-field models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01432)
*Mengyi Chen,Peichen Zhong,Zihan Zhang,Qianxiao Li*

Main category: cond-mat.stat-mech

TL;DR: 提出从第一性原理数据学习相场模型的框架：通过Mori-Zwanzig投影将分子动力学严格映射到组分密度场，得到介观演化方程，其非局域自由能与迁移率由神经网络参数化并从高精度机器学习势的短程MD轨迹中学习。在铁硼熔体与氢氦混合物上验证，实现了兼具从头算精度与介观尺度的模拟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模拟微结构演化同时需要量子力学精度和介观时空尺度，但现有方法无法兼顾：经典相场模型可达介观尺度，却受限于唯象自由能与迁移率导致的精度不足；原子尺度方法精度高但尺度受限。因此需要一种既保持从头算精度又能扩展到介观尺度的建模框架。

Method: 在明确假设下，通过Mori-Zwanzig投影将分子动力学投影到组分密度场，导出（而非假设）介观相场方程；方程中未确定的非局域自由能与迁移率用神经网络参数化，并利用从头算精度机器学习原子间势生成的短程MD轨迹进行学习。据此外推模拟大尺度体系，例如捕获液滴成核与生长的氢氦"氦雨"模拟。

Result: 在铁硼熔体与行星条件下氢氦混合物上验证：铁硼体系中，FeB4组分熔体在常压下呈亚稳旋节分解、在10 GPa下稳定，为FeB4仅能在高压下合成提供热力学解释；氢氦体系中，模型预测不混溶边界，并在对应220万个原子的柱状氦雨模拟中捕获液滴成核与生长，尺度远超同等精度的原子模拟。

Conclusion: 该框架可学习兼具从头算精度与介观尺度的相场模型，是原子尺度从头算分子动力学的介观对应物。若跨组分与条件训练，此类模型有望在保持量子力学精度的同时实现介观时空尺度模拟，为微结构演化模拟提供新范式。

Abstract: Simulating microstructure evolution requires quantum-mechanical accuracy and mesoscopic reach in length and time scales, a combination that no current method achieves. Classical phase-field models provide this reach, but their accuracy is limited by phenomenological free energies and mobilities. Here we develop a framework for learning ab initio phase-field models, where the mesoscopic equation is not postulated but derived from a Mori-Zwanzig projection of molecular dynamics onto species-density fields under explicit assumptions. The nonlocal free energy and mobility left unspecified by this equation are parametrized by neural networks and learned from short molecular dynamics trajectories generated with machine-learning interatomic potentials of ab initio accuracy. We demonstrate the framework on an iron-boron melt and on hydrogen-helium mixtures under planetary conditions. For iron-boron, the model shows that the melt at the FeB$_4$ composition is spinodally unstable at ambient pressure but stabilized at 10 GPa, offering a thermodynamic rationale for why FeB$_4$ has been synthesized only under high pressure. For hydrogen-helium, the model predicts the immiscibility boundary and captures droplet nucleation and growth in helium-rain simulations of a column corresponding to 2.2 million atoms, far beyond the scale of atomistic modeling at comparable accuracy. Trained across compositions and conditions, such models could provide a mesoscopic counterpart to ab initio molecular dynamics.

</details>


### [319] [Gate Control Improves Routing Efficiency for Periodic Traffic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01534)
*Hyunwook Song,Hoyun Choi,B. Kahng*

Main category: cond-mat.stat-mech

TL;DR: 本文提出一种结合门控的双队列方案，用于缓解高速公路等复杂网络中的交通拥堵，并改善拥塞相变特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有关于复杂网络交通流优化的研究多集中于单队列模型，难以刻画实际交通中周期性、大幅波动的入流情形，也未能有效改善系统的失效（拥塞）特性。

Method: 引入一个简单而有效的双队列方案，并在匝道入口设置门控（gate control）以调控车辆进入：车辆到达匝道后先进入等待队列，仅当主干流动队列排空后才被允许进入；该规则仅依赖局部队列信息，并与路由协议相集成。

Result: 该双队列策略在入流呈周期性且波动较大时尤为有效；同时改变了系统的失效特性，将突发性的、不连续的拥塞相变转变为渐进的、连续的相变。

Conclusion: 该方案基于简单规则、仅需局部队列信息，易于实现且适用性广，可推广至不同条件下的其他交通网络，或扩展至互联网数据包路由等其他排队系统。

Abstract: Traffic movement on highways and data packet transmission across the Internet serve as prototypical examples of collective dynamical behavior in complex systems. Although enhancing traffic flow in complex networks has been extensively investigated, most existing studies focus on single-queue models. In this paper, we introduce a simple yet effective two-queue scheme with gate control that regulates vehicle entry and integrates it with the routing protocol. When vehicles arrive at a on-ramp gate, they first join a waiting queue and are permitted to enter the main flowing queue once it has emptied. This two-queue strategy is especially advantageous when highway inflow varies periodically with large fluctuations, as is commonly observed in real traffic. Moreover, it modifies the system's failure characteristics, replacing sudden, discontinuous jamming transitions with gradual, continuous ones. The approach is based on a simple rule using only local queue information, making it easy to implement and widely applicable. Beyond the specific setup studied here, it can be applied to other transportation networks under different conditions or extended to other queuing systems, such as Internet data packet routing.

</details>


### [320] [Optimal sampling strategies in event-chain Monte Carlo](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01659)
*James Gulliford,Gareth O. Roberts,Michael F. Faulkner*

Main category: cond-mat.stat-mech

TL;DR: 本文提出一个通用框架，将高效的事件链蒙特卡洛（ECMC）采样策略推广至环面上所有平移对称的成对相互作用模型，有望在采样效率上超越MD和HMC成为领先方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MD、HMC和ECMC均通过确定性轨迹推进粒子以超越随机游走Metropolis算法，但ECMC不受牛顿动力学约束，具有更大动力学自由度。此前在一维环面N粒子模型上利用该自由度实现了O(N^{3/4})效率提升，但在一般吸引/排斥相互作用下低/高粒子密度时的前置因子过小，实用性受限。作者希望将这一高效策略推广到更普遍的模型。

Method: 提出一个通用框架，将此前的高效采样策略推广至环面上所有平移对称的成对模型，并利用ECMC的动力学自由度诱导集体粒子动力学，在快时间尺度上弛豫局部密度变化。同时通过数值方法阐明该集体粒子动力学。

Result: 该框架将高效率采样策略成功推广到所有平移对称成对模型，克服了此前前置因子过小的实用性限制，从而具备超越MD和HMC成为最新领先方法的潜力；并通过数值实验刻画了集体粒子动力学行为。

Conclusion: 该通用框架提升了ECMC在广泛成对模型上的采样效率，有望成为计算采样领域的新标杆，并对物理科学和计算统计学产生广泛影响。

Abstract: Event-chain Monte Carlo (ECMC) has revolutionised computational sampling over recent years, providing a powerful alternative to the molecular-dynamics (MD) and Hamiltonian Monte Carlo (HMC) algorithms. Each method outperforms the ubiquitous random-walk Metropolis algorithm by advancing particles along deterministic trajectories, but ECMC achieves this without being constrained by Newtonian dynamics. Recent advances exploited this dynamical freedom to induce a collective particle dynamics that relax local density variations on fast timescales. In a foundational model of $N$ pairwise-interacting particles on the 1D torus, this led to an $O(N^{3/4})$ improvement on the industry-leading computational efficiency of MD and HMC - but with an impractically small prefactor at low/high mean particle density for general attractive/repulsive interactions. Here we present a universal framework that generalises this high-efficiency sampling strategy to all translationally symmetric pairwise models on the torus - creating the potential to surpass MD and HMC as the state of the art. We also numerically elucidate the collective particle dynamics and discuss broad impact across the physical sciences and computational statistics.

</details>


### [321] [Scalar field theory for (chiral) active Brownian particles: bottom-up derivation revisited](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01672)
*Yuta Kuroda,Thomas Speck*

Main category: cond-mat.stat-mech

TL;DR: 本文综述并推导了活性布朗粒子（ABP）模型与其对应标量活性场理论之间的联系，基于压力展开与重整化群（RG）方法，从微观层面系统导出包含四阶空间梯度项的标量场理论，并将该方法推广至手性ABP模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标量活性流体的宏观行为常用自上而下方式构建的标量活性场理论描述，但其与粒子模型（如ABP）的微观联系尚不清晰，缺乏系统性推导，本文旨在推进这一微观导出工作。

Method: 采用压力展开与奇异微扰理论背景下的重整化群（RG）方法，系统消除快变量并识别慢不变流形上的动力学，将标量场理论作为RG流方程获得；同时将方法应用于手性ABP（cABP）模型。

Result: 成功建立了二维相互作用ABP与包含最高四阶空间梯度项标量场理论之间的联系；发现cABP对应的标量场理论在ABP理论基础上额外包含两个"odd"项。

Conclusion: 该RG方法为从微观粒子模型系统导出标量活性场理论提供了有效途径，并有望推广至其他类型活性物质系统的流体力学描述。

Abstract: The active Brownian particle (ABP) model is one of the most widely used particle-based models in studies of scalar active fluids. A collection of interacting ABPs is known to exhibit intriguing phenomena that are absent in equilibrium counterparts. A prominent example is spontaneous phase separation, known as motility-induced phase separation (MIPS), which occurs even in the absence of explicit attractive interactions. In parallel, the large-scale behavior of scalar active fluids is often modeled using continuum descriptions, namely, scalar field theories. Such scalar active field theories are usually formulated in a top-down manner, and establishing their connections to particle-based models remains challenging, with these connections not yet fully understood. To advance the microscopic derivation of scalar active field theories, we revisit the connection between ABPs interacting via a two-body potential in two dimensions and scalar field theories that include all possible terms up to fourth order in spatial gradients. Our approach is based on a pressure expansion and the renormalization group (RG) method in the context of singular perturbation theory. The RG method provides a systematic way to eliminate fast variables and identify the dynamics on the slow invariant manifold. Within this framework, scalar field theories can be obtained as RG flow equations. We also apply this method to a chiral variant of the ABP model, the chiral ABP (cABP) model, in which a constant torque biases particle rotation to the left or right. We show that the scalar field theory corresponding to the cABP model contains two ``odd'' terms in addition to those present in the scalar field theory for ABPs. The method developed here may also be useful for deriving hydrodynamic descriptions of other types of active matter systems.

</details>


<div id='math.AG'></div>

# math.AG [[Back]](#toc)

### [322] [Direct Group Laws on Classical Genus-One Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00029)
*Hongfeng Wu*

Main category: math.AG

TL;DR: 本文以"剩余交点"方法统一构造多种椭圆曲线模型上的群律，并借助亏格一曲线的亚纯函数理论证明结合律。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有文献中各类椭圆曲线模型（短Weierstrass、Edwards、Hessian、Jacobi quartic、Jacobi intersection、Huff、QRT等）的群运算公式往往各自独立推导，缺乏统一的构造与结合律证明框架。作者希望通过剩余交点这一几何视角，给出这些模型群律的统一处理方式，并明确各公式适用的特征范围（包括特征2、3）。

Method: 利用剩余交点（residual intersection）构造群律：在平面三次曲线上，以直线给出群运算；在PP^3中两条二次曲面的光滑交上，以平面给出群运算。结合律的证明方法是比较三个直线方程（或平面方程）的两种乘积方式，消去公共零点后，由"亏格一的光滑射影曲线不存在恰有一个单极点的非常值有理函数"这一初等事实得到剩余零点相等。所处理的模型包括短Weierstrass三次曲线、曲线(u^2+u)(v^2+v)=d、Edwards曲线、Hessian曲线、Jacobi quartic曲线、Jacobi intersection曲线、Huff曲线以及对称QRT双二次曲线。

Result: 对上述各模型给出了基于剩余交点的群律构造及结合律证明。(u^2+u)(v^2+v)=d的公式在任意特征下均成立，并在特征2与特征3下显式写出；其余模型在特征不等于2和3的情形下处理。

Conclusion: 剩余交点方法为多种椭圆曲线模型的群律提供了统一、几何化的构造与结合律证明，且"亏格一曲线无仅含一个单极点的非常值有理函数"这一事实是关键工具；该方法特别覆盖了特征2与特征3下的情形。

Abstract: This exposition constructs group laws by residual intersection on short Weierstrass cubics, the curves $(u^2+u)(v^2+v)=d$, Edwards curves, Hessian curves, Jacobi quartics curves, Jacobi intersections curves, Huff curves, and a symmetric QRT biquadratic. Lines give the operation on plane cubics, while planes give the operation on smooth intersections of two quadrics in $\PP^3$. Associativity is proved by comparing two products of three line or plane equations. After the common zeros are cancelled, equality of the remaining zeros follows from the elementary fact that a smooth projective curve of genus one admits no nonconstant rational function with one simple pole. The formulas for $(u^2+u)(v^2+v)=d$ are valid in every characteristic and are written explicitly in characteristics $2$ and $3$; the other models are treated in characteristic different from $2$ and $3$.

</details>


### [323] [Categorical Torelli theorem for (weighted) hypersurfaces via singularity category](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00130)
*Xun Lin,Jieheng Zeng,Shizhuo Zhang*

Main category: math.AG

TL;DR: 该论文利用完备仿射锥的奇点范畴，证明了普通与加权超曲面的范畴Torelli定理：Fano情形使用Kuznetsov分量，一般型情形使用分次矩阵分解全范畴。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为超曲面（含Fano与一般型）建立范畴Torelli定理，尤其是加权与一般型情形，统一并推广已有结果。

Method: 取完备仿射锥的奇点范畴。Fano超曲面用Kuznetsov分量，一般型超曲面用分次矩阵分解全范畴。当次数与权重之和互素时，将内部分次移位用Serre函子与上同调移位表达，得到其dg轨道是内蕴的；取perfect hull后与完备锥的dg奇点范畴一致。再由范畴Mather–Yau定理恢复形式奇点。

Result: 普通齐次方程时，形式等价诱导射影线性等价；加权情形下对偶环面作用决定Tjurina代数的分次，从而决定加权齐次方程。在给定数值假设下给出Fano超曲面的统一证明，并证明了一般型超曲面的新范畴Torelli定理。

Conclusion: 该框架以锥的奇点范畴为桥梁，通过内蕴分次移位与范畴Mather–Yau定理，统一处理Fano与一般型超曲面，并给出加权情形的新Torelli定理。

Abstract: We prove categorical Torelli theorems for ordinary and weighted hypersurfaces using the singularity category of the completed affine cone. For Fano hypersurfaces we use the Kuznetsov component, whereas for hypersurfaces of general type we use the full category of graded matrix factorizations. When the degree is coprime to the sum of the weights, the internal grading shift can be expressed in terms of the Serre functor and the cohomological shift. Its dg orbit is therefore intrinsic and, after taking the perfect hull, agrees with the dg singularity category of the completed cone. The formal singularity is then recovered by the categorical Mather--Yau theorem. For ordinary homogeneous equations, the resulting formal equivalence induces a projective linear equivalence; in the weighted setting the dual torus action determines the grading of the Tjurina algebra and hence the weighted homogeneous equation. The argument gives a uniform proof for Fano hypersurfaces under the stated numerical assumptions and proves new categorical Torelli theorems for hypersurfaces of general type.

</details>


### [324] [Completed cycle transfer and the conifold gap for (P^2, E)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00179)
*Xiaobin Li*

Main category: math.AG

TL;DR: 该文证明了一个关于连通椭圆完备环路迹的正则性定理，并由此建立了射影平面上极大接触相对Gromov-Witten理论的Nekrasov-Shatashvili conifold gap，说明极化部分的极点与有限部分均由真空常数决定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: conifold边界条件虽约束高亏格拓扑弦自由能，但其主导奇异行为并不自动保证次主导极点的抵消，因此需要更精细的正则性结果来确立gap性质并连接局部与相对理论。

Method: 证明连通椭圆完备环路迹的正则性定理；利用高亏格局部/相对对应将普通势表示为相对势与低亏格微分贡献；识别conifold极化修正为椭圆迹；通过中心差分恒等式将非真空分划权重重和为content product乘正则指数；并用三角归纳转移已知的普通局部射影平面gap。

Result: 对任意正则输入势部分和具有单零点的nome，归一化非真空连通贡献可被conifold坐标与耦合平方整除；整个极点部分与有限部分由真空常数决定；获得有限部分恒等式、正则Taylor系数的有限公式及全纯模糊性的重构。

Conclusion: 该论证在耦合上形式地成立，并在每个固定亏格给出全纯余项，从而将普通局部射影平面gap传递到相对理论，确立了所需的正则性与conifold gap。

Abstract: Conifold boundary conditions constrain higher genus topological string free energies, but the cancellation of subleading poles is not implied by their leading singular behavior. We prove a regularity theorem for connected elliptic completed cycle traces and use it to establish the Nekrasov-Shatashvili conifold gap for the maximal contact relative Gromov-Witten theory of the projective plane with a smooth cubic boundary and a top Hodge class insertion. The higher genus local/relative correspondence expresses the ordinary potential in terms of the relative potential and differentiated lower genus contributions. We identify its conifold polarized correction with an elliptic trace. A central difference identity resums each non-vacuum partition weight into a content product multiplied by a regular exponential. For arbitrary regular parts of the input potentials and any nome with a simple zero, the normalized non-vacuum connected contribution is divisible by the conifold coordinate and by the square of the coupling. The entire polar part and finite part are consequently determined by the vacuum constants. A triangular induction transfers the known ordinary local projective plane gap to the relative theory. We also obtain finite part identities, finite formulas for regular Taylor coefficients, and reconstruction of the holomorphic ambiguities. The argument is formal in the coupling and gives holomorphic remainders at every fixed genus.

</details>


### [325] [Contraction Algebras, Cyclotomic Forms, and Reflection Rigidity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00263)
*Xiaobin Li*

Main category: math.AG

TL;DR: 本文将有限块大小数据与分圆形式和 Householder 反射表示相联系，证明了一个算术刚性结果：反射群有限当且仅当它保持满秩格，等价于支撑为 {1,N} 且 n₁=N²n_N，此时群为 W(A_N)≅S_{N+1}；并应用于三fold flop的收缩代数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者希望将有限块大小数据（如分裂半单代数的 Wedderburn 重数）编码为一个分圆形式和 Householder 反射表示，并通过傅里叶谱的重建性质建立数据与代数同构型之间的联系，进而研究反射群的有限性与算术刚性，并将其应用于三fold flop的收缩代数。

Method: 对数据 n=(n_d) 定义正定分圆形式 B_n(g,h)=（1/þ）Σ_{(g^{-1}h)^d=1} d²n_d，其中 N=lcm{d:n_d≠0}，þ=Σ_d d²n_d，并构造相应的 Householder 反射表示。利用标记傅里叶谱与 Möbius 反演重建重数序列。对分裂半单代数 S=∏_d M_d(k)^{n_d}，将整除宽度解释为 Wedderburn 块的特征和的维数。进而研究反射群保持满秩格与群有限性的等价条件，并借助 Toda 的宽度公式分析三fold flop的收缩代数。

Result: 主要定理：对 N≥2，反射群有限当且仅当它保持满秩格，等价于 supp(n)={1,N} 且 n_1=N²n_N；此时 B_n=(1/2)(I+J)，群为 W(A_N)≅S_{N+1}。半单代数下有限性等价于 S≅k^{N²m}×M_N(k)^m。N=2 时所有非有限情形是对应正交群中 D_∞ 的稠密拷贝。对三fold flop的收缩代数，Toda 宽度公式将总尺度与原始傅里叶模识别为 dim A_con 与 dim A_con^{ab}，从而证明长度至少三的不可约 flop 均为无限，长度二时 Γ_f 有限 ⟺ dim A_con=2 dim A_con^{ab}。

Conclusion: 本文建立了有限块大小数据、分圆形式、Householder 反射群与分裂半单代数同构型之间的算术刚性对应，刻画了反射群有限性的精确条件，并在三fold flop的收缩代数上给出了有限性判据；最后提供了同一反射矩阵的 BPS/Riemann–Hilbert 互补实现。

Abstract: We associate to finite block size data \[ \bm n=(n_d)_{d\ge1},\qquad n_1>0, \] a positive definite cyclotomic form and a Householder reflection representation. Writing \[ N=\operatorname{lcm}\{d:n_d\ne0\},\qquad \wt=\sum_d d^2n_d, \] the form on the cyclic group $C_N$ is \[ B_{\bm n}(g,h)=\frac1{\wt}\sum_{(g^{-1}h)^d=1}d^2n_d. \] Its labelled Fourier spectrum reconstructs the complete multiplicity sequence by Möbius inversion. If the $n_d$ are the Wedderburn multiplicities of a split semisimple algebra $S=\prod_d M_d(k)^{n_d}$, the divisibility widths are dimensions of characteristic sums of Wedderburn blocks, and the form together with $\dim_kS$ recovers the isomorphism type of $S$.
  The main theorem is an arithmetic rigidity result. For $N\ge2$, the reflection group is finite if and only if it preserves a full rank lattice, equivalently \[ \supp(\bm n)=\{1,N\},\qquad n_1=N^2n_N. \] In this case $B_{\bm n}=\frac12(I+J)$ and the group is $W(A_N)\cong S_{N+1}$. In semisimple algebra terms, finiteness is equivalent to \[ S\cong k^{N^2m}\times M_N(k)^m \] for some $m\ge1$. For $N=2$, every nonfinite case is a dense copy of $D_\infty$ in the corresponding orthogonal group.
  For contraction algebras of threefold flops, Toda's width formulas identify the total scale and primitive Fourier mode with $\dim A_{\con}$ and $\dim A_{\con}^{\ab}$. This yields infinitude for all irreducible flops of length at least three and, in length two, \[ Γ_f\text{ finite}\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad \dim A_{\con}=2\dim A_{\con}^{\ab}. \] The final part gives a complementary BPS/Riemann--Hilbert realization of the same reflection matrices.

</details>


### [326] [A characterization of the Ree curve](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00189)
*Saeed Tafazolian*

Main category: math.AG

TL;DR: 证明：在 q=3q₀²（q₀=3ˢ, s≥3）上具有 q³+1 个有理点且亏格为 (3/2)q₀(q−1)(q+q₀+1) 的光滑射影几何不可约曲线，必与 Ree 曲线 F_q-同构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Ree 曲线是有限域上达到极大有理点数的著名曲线。已有结果多刻画其点数和亏格，本文旨在给出一个刚性刻画：仅由有理点数目与亏格两个数值不变量即可唯一确定该曲线（在同构意义下），从而确认其在给定参数下的唯一性。

Method: 取 q=3q₀²，q₀=3ˢ（s≥3）。设 X 为 F_q 上光滑、射影、几何不可约曲线，已知 |X(F_q)|=q³+1，亏格 g=(3/2)q₀(q−1)(q+q₀+1)。通过比较该点数为 Hasse-Weil 上界（约 q+1+2g√q）的极大值，判定 X 为 F_q-极大曲线，再结合极大曲线的标准理论（如 Weierstrass 点、自同构群、zeta 函数及 ree 曲线的本原性质）证明 X 与 Ree 曲线同构。

Result: 证明了满足上述点数和亏格条件的曲线 X 必 F_q-同构于 Ree 曲线，即该曲线被这两个数值不变量唯一确定。

Conclusion: Ree 曲线在具有 q³+1 个有理点及相应亏格的曲线类中是唯一的，说明其在极大曲线理论中具有刚性/极端地位。

Abstract: Let $q=3q_0^2$, where $q_0=3^s$ and $s\ge3$. We prove that a smooth, projective, geometrically irreducible curve over $\F_q$ with $q^3+1$ rational points and genus \[
  \frac32q_0(q-1)(q+q_0+1) \] is $\F_q$-isomorphic to the Ree curve.

</details>


### [327] [Supermoduli spaces are non-projected in every genus $g\geq 3$](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00490)
*Mauricio Corrêa,Ron Donagi,Simone Noja*

Main category: math.AG

TL;DR: 证明了对每个亏格 g≥3，光滑无 punctured 超 Riemann 曲面模超叠的奇偶两分支的一级障碍在代数与全纯意义下均非零，因而两分支均非投影、非分裂。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究超 Riemann 曲面模空间的投影性与分裂性问题：是否存在到其约化自旋曲线模叠的代数或全纯收缩。

Method: 计算光滑无 punctured 超 Riemann 曲面模超叠奇偶分支的一级障碍（primary obstruction），并在代数与全纯两个范畴中进行论证。

Result: 对每个亏格 g≥3，两分支的一级障碍在代数与全纯意义下均非零。

Conclusion: 两分支均非投影（non-projected）且非分裂（non-split），即不存在到约化自旋曲线模叠的代数或全纯收缩。

Abstract: We prove that, for every genus $g\geq 3$, the primary obstruction of each parity component of the moduli superstack of smooth unpunctured super Riemann surfaces is nonzero, both algebraically and holomorphically. Consequently, both components are non-projected and, in particular, non-split: neither admits an algebraic or holomorphic retraction onto its reduced moduli stack of spin curves.

</details>


### [328] [All Genus Gopakumar-Vafa Reconstruction from Central Difference Forcing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00217)
*Xiaobin Li*

Main category: math.AG

TL;DR: 该论文引入一个中心差分算子，将曲线计数生成函数中的多重覆盖效应与BPS亏格效应精确分离，并给出可逆变换、算术刻画及局部曲线几何实现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 曲线计数生成函数混合了两类信息：多重覆盖混合曲线度数，拓扑弦耦合混合BPS亏格。需要一种精确且可逆的方式将二者分离，从而理解全亏格Gopakumar-Vafa展开的结构。

Method: 沿Calabi-Yau三维簇的有效射线，定义中心差分算子并令 y=(2 sin(λ/2))^2；结合Bryan-Pandharipande覆盖多项式与相应Fejér因子，构造归一化差分forcing的Chebyshev-Fejér ghost transform，并给出其算子值Möbius逆；研究其y-adic滤过与积分像。

Result: 变换的y-adic滤过恰为BPS亏格滤过：forcing模y^{G+1}等价于亏格至多G的全部BPS不变量，故经典特化的亏格零重构是全亏格层级的第一个关联分次片。积分BPS forcing等价于两阶段条件：ghost坐标的Witt-Dwork型Frobenius同余，加上中心差分算子施加的Fejér整除条件；在素幂次数下给出含完整Fejér因子的加强Dwork同余。局部曲线情形有具体几何实现：超刚性椭圆曲线给出forcing的精确Dedekind η表达式；平衡高亏格局部曲线理论中，上次数二BPS不变量实现为对称积上平方根自然叠的top Chern数。

Conclusion: 中心差分方程与BPS重构、算术ghost结构及局部曲线几何相连接，为全亏格Gopakumar-Vafa展开提供了一个统一且可逆的分离框架。

Abstract: Generating functions in curve counting theory mix two different kinds of information: multiple covers mix curve degrees, while the topological string coupling mixes BPS genera. We show that a single central difference operator separates these two effects in a precise and invertible way for the all genus Gopakumar-Vafa expansion along an effective ray of a Calabi-Yau threefold.
  Writing \[ y=\left(2\sin\fracλ{2}\right)^2, \] we combine the Bryan-Pandharipande cover polynomials with the corresponding Fejér factors and obtain a Chebyshev-Fejér ghost transform for the normalized difference forcing. The transform admits an explicit operator-valued Möbius inverse. Its $y$-adic filtration is exactly the BPS genus filtration: the forcing modulo $y^{G+1}$ is equivalent to the complete collection of BPS invariants of genera at most $G$. Thus the genus zero reconstruction from the classical specialization is the first associated graded piece of an all genus hierarchy.
  We also characterize the integral image of the transform. Integral BPS forcing is equivalent to a two stage condition: Witt-Dwork type Frobenius congruences for the underlying ghost coordinates, together with an additional Fejér divisibility condition imposed by the central difference operator. In prime power degree this gives a strengthened Dwork congruence containing the full Fejér factor.
  For local curves, the formalism has concrete geometric realizations. A super-rigid elliptic curve gives an exact Dedekind $η$ expression for the forcing. In the balanced higher genus local curve theory, the upper degree two BPS invariants are realized as top Chern numbers on natural stacks of square roots over symmetric products. These results connect central difference equations with BPS reconstruction, arithmetic ghost structures, and the geometry of local curves.

</details>


### [329] [Pentagram relations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00225)
*Nikita Markarian*

Main category: math.AG

TL;DR: 研究五点有理曲线模空间上迭代Kummer扩张的上同调。通过二维收缩构造比较五条遗忘投影给出的Betti表示，由Hodge缺陷得到五角星关系，即Drinfeld associator系数间的二次关系，在群似、归一化与反转条件下等价于五边形方程。反转与纯幂系数消失下，这些关系蕴含shuffle与正则化双重shuffle关系，其Hodge实现可由卷积特化恢复。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 延续对五点有理曲线模空间上迭代Kummer扩张上同调的研究，旨在通过比较不同遗忘投影诱导的Betti表示，揭示Drinfeld associator系数之间的隐藏关系及其与已知方程（五边形方程、双重shuffle关系）的联系。

Method: 采用二维收缩构造，比较由五条遗忘投影得到的Betti表示，并以Hodge缺陷作为工具导出所谓的五角星关系（associator系数间的二次关系）。进一步施加群似、归一化、反转以及纯幂系数消失等条件进行分析。

Result: 得到的五角星关系在群似、归一化与反转条件下等价于五边形方程；在反转与纯幂系数消失条件下，这些关系蕴含shuffle与正则化双重shuffle关系，且其Hodge实现可由卷积特化恢复。

Conclusion: 该工作将模空间上同调的几何构造与Drinfeld associator的代数关系联系起来，为五边形方程及双重shuffle关系提供了新的Hodge理论解释。

Abstract: We study the cohomology of iterated Kummer extensions on the moduli space of five-pointed rational curves, continuing [arXiv:2609.19341, arXiv:2609.21356]. A two-dimensional shrinking construction compares the Betti presentations obtained from its five forgetful projections. The corresponding Hodge defects give pentagram relations, quadratic relations between coefficients of the Drinfeld associator, which are equivalent to the pentagon equation under group-likeness, normalization, and reversal. Under reversal and vanishing of pure-power coefficients, the relations imply shuffle and regularized double shuffle, whose Hodge realization is recovered by a convolution specialization.

</details>


### [330] [Conifold factorization in topological recursion and Gromov--Witten theory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01557)
*Juping Chen,Linji Chen,Bohan Fang,Zhengyu Zong*

Main category: math.AG

TL;DR: 证明了普通拓扑递归在 spectral curve 正则节退化附近（允许对数 spectral 坐标）的因式分解定理：闭合亏格 $g\ge2$ 的配分函数分解为归一化配分函数、普适高斯真空与连通图求和的指数三部分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究拓扑递归在 spectral curve 正则节退化（nodal degeneration）处的行为，特别是允许对数 spectral 坐标的情形，以刻画 conifold gap 现象并就消失周期的正整数次幂给出有限图公式。

Method: 证明正则节退化附近的因式分解定理；将高斯颈张量用参数化 $\mathbb P^1$ 的相对 Gromov–Witten 不变量表示；固定亏格下证明正则级数关于周期与节点轨迹参数联合收敛；并借助 remodeling 应用于实例。

Result: 因式分解中图求和在消失周期中具严格正阶，从而恢复 conifold gap，将零次项等同于归一化自由能，并给出正幂系数的有限图公式。得到局部 $\mathbb P^2$ 与局部 $\mathbb F_0$ 在 conifold frame 下的 Gromov–Witten 因式分解，背景分别为 $\mathbb C^3$ 与 resolved conifold；局部 $\mathbb F_1$ 的类似因式分解背景为 $\mathbb P^1$ 上的 $\mathcal O(1)\oplus\mathcal O(-3)$。

Conclusion: 该因式分解定理统一刻画了正则节退化下拓扑递归的结构，揭示 conifold gap 的机制，并通过 remodeling 建立与相对 Gromov–Witten 理论的联系。

Abstract: We prove a factorization theorem for ordinary topological recursion near a regular nodal degeneration of a spectral curve, allowing logarithmic spectral coordinates. The partition function for closed genera $g\ge2$ factors into the partition function of the normalization, a universal Gaussian vacuum, and the exponential of a connected graph sum. This graph sum has strictly positive order in the vanishing period, and thus the factorization recovers the conifold gap, identifies the term of degree zero in the vanishing period with the free energy of the normalization, and gives finite graph formulas for the coefficients of positive powers of the period. At fixed genus, the regular series converges jointly in the period and the parameters along the nodal locus. The Gaussian neck tensors can be expressed in terms of relative Gromov--Witten invariants of a parametrized $\mathbb P^1$. As examples, we use remodeling to obtain Gromov--Witten factorizations for local $\mathbb P^2$ and local $\mathbb F_0$ in the conifold frame, with backgrounds $\mathbb C^3$ and the resolved conifold, respectively. The analogous local $\mathbb F_1$ factorization has background $\mathcal O(1)\oplus\mathcal O(-3)$ over $\mathbb P^1$.

</details>


### [331] [Derivative and multiplicity loci of elementary symmetric polynomials in positive characteristic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00259)
*Ying Xie*

Main category: math.AG

TL;DR: 本文确定了正特征代数闭域上初等对称多项式的所有导数轨迹与高重数轨迹的维数，并刻画了其分支、奇点、局部环、稳定子概形与 Frobenius 标准形。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 初等对称多项式的高重数轨迹和导数零轨迹的维数问题与 Orzel 猜想相关，但正特征下维数行为随特征变化而出现跳跃与增厚现象，需要统一刻画其对特征的依赖。

Method: 对 n 元 d 次多项式设 Q = p^{v_p(n-d+1)}，分别计算 order-q 导数公共零轨迹及重数至少为 s 的零轨迹的维数；分析各分支的维数、光滑性、局部环与重数；并确定平移稳定子概形并导出 Frobenius 标准形。

Result: order-q 导数公共零轨迹维数为 d - q - 1 + 1_{Q>d-q}；重数至少 s 的零轨迹维数为 d - s + 1_{Q>d}。order-two 情形解决 Orzel 猜想中的维数问题，并在 d 为 p 的幂时需作必要修正。分类出达到较大维数的所有分支并证明其一般光滑；较小维数情形下沿坐标分支确定局部环，得到一般重数恰为 Q。

Conclusion: 结果区分了维数跳跃与无穷小增厚，统一描述了它们对特征的依赖，给出了正特征下初等对称多项式退化轨迹的完整维数与分支结构。

Abstract: We determine the dimensions of all derivative loci and all higher multiplicity loci of an elementary symmetric polynomial over an algebraically closed field of positive characteristic. For the degree-d polynomial in n variables, set Q = p^{v_p(n-d+1)}. The common zero locus of its order-q derivatives has dimension d - q - 1 + 1_{Q>d-q}, whereas the locus of zeros of multiplicity at least s has dimension d - s + 1_{Q>d}. The order-two case settles the dimension question in a conjecture of Orzel, with a necessary correction when d is a power of p. We classify all components attaining the larger dimension and prove that they are generically smooth. Along the coordinate components in the smaller-dimension cases, we determine the local rings and obtain generic multiplicity exactly Q. Finally, we identify the full translation stabilizer scheme and derive a Frobenius normal form. These results distinguish dimension jumps from infinitesimal thickening and give a uniform description of their dependence on the characteristic.

</details>


### [332] [Motivic Vanishing Cycles at Infinity and Toric Landau-Ginzburg Mirror Symmetry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00289)
*Haoxu Wang*

Main category: math.AG

TL;DR: 该文证明了在适当的简单正规交叉假设下，由 1/f 定义的 open-pair 类与 Raibaut 的与紧化无关的 motivic nearby cycle at infinity 一致，并由此给出非退化 Laurent 多项式的 toric 证明、Newton 公式、不规则 Hodge 数、toric stacky fan 的零势能 stringy 不变量以及 Fano-Landau-Ginzburg 镜像恒等式，并在弱 Fano 情形下识别单值特征值与 Jordan 块。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者希望把 motivic nearby cycles at infinity 与在有理紧化上直接计算的类进行比较，从而获得一个与紧化无关的框架，并推广 Raibaut 的 essential-face 公式，同时把 Hodge 实现、Ehrhart 理论和镜像对称联系起来。

Method: 设 f 是特征零域上光滑簇的正则函数，X 是光滑 proper 紧化；假设包含边界和 div_X(f) 支集的约化除子在极 locus 附近具有简单正规交叉。通过在 transverse zero-pole intersections 的 blow-up 下的局部抵消，证明由 1/f 定义的 open-pair 类与 Raibaut 的紧化无关 motivic nearby cycle at infinity 一致。再利用等变 Hodge 实现和加权 Ehrhart 理论。

Result: 证明该比较定理；对非退化于无穷的 Laurent 多项式给出 Raibaut essential-face 公式的直接 toric 证明；Newton 公式保留上同调次数和 limit-weight filtration；确定 irregular Hodge numbers；weight-forgetting 特化计算具有相同径向支集的 toric stacky fans 的 zero-potential stringy invariant，并得到 Fano-Landau-Ginzburg 镜像恒等式的 motivic-Hodge 推导；在全维弱 Fano 情形下识别单值特征值和 Jordan 块大小。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了 motivic nearby cycles at infinity 与紧化上直接计算之间的比较，统一并细化了 Raibaut 的公式与镜像对称中的 Hodge 理论结果，并在弱 Fano 情形给出在 C 上的非典范比较。

Abstract: We compare motivic nearby cycles at infinity with classes computed directly on rational compactifications. Let $f$ be a regular function on a smooth variety over a field of characteristic zero, and let $X$ be a smooth proper compactification. Suppose that a reduced divisor containing the boundary and the support of $\operatorname{div}_X(f)$ has simple normal crossings near the polar locus. We prove that the open-pair class defined by $1/f$ agrees with Raibaut's compactification-independent motivic nearby cycle at infinity. The key step is a local cancellation under blow-ups of transverse zero-pole intersections.
  For Laurent polynomials nondegenerate at infinity, this comparison yields a direct toric proof of Raibaut's essential-face formula. Equivariant Hodge realization and weighted Ehrhart theory give Newton formulas retaining cohomological degree and the limit-weight filtration, and determine irregular Hodge numbers through the limiting-irregular comparison. The weight-forgetting specialization computes the zero-potential stringy invariant of toric stacky fans with the same radial support, yielding a motivic-Hodge derivation of the corresponding Fano-Landau-Ginzburg mirror identity. In the full-dimensional weak Fano case, the refined formulas identify monodromy eigenvalues and Jordan-block sizes with inertia ages and anticanonical Lefschetz strings, giving a noncanonical comparison over $\mathbb C$.

</details>


### [333] [Transcending Algebraic Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00335)
*Carlos Simpson*

Main category: math.AG

TL;DR: 本文梳理并阐述引导至Jacob Tsimerman在算术与代数几何中发展o-minimal可定义性理论的若干核心思想。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在综述推动Tsimerman开创性工作的思想脉络，帮助读者理解该理论的来龙去脉。

Method: 以评述/综述（exposition）的方式，梳理相关思想的发展线索。

Result: 给出了通向Tsimerman在算术与代数几何中o-minimal可定义性理论工作的思想阐述。

Conclusion: 该文为理解Tsimerman开创性理论提供了思想性的导引与背景铺垫。

Abstract: We give an exposition of some of the ideas leading up to Jacob Tsimerman's groundbreaking work developing the theory of o-minimal definability in arithmetic and algebraic geometry.

</details>


### [334] [A Pluripotential-Theoretic Approach to Finiteness of Polarized Calabi--Yau Manifolds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00361)
*Truong Dinh Dat*

Main category: math.AG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个利用整体\(m\)-Hessian容量研究极化Calabi-Yau流形有限性问题的一般位势论框架，将容量估计、体积-容量不等式、容量-周长估计与Sobolev界、非塌缩、度量紧性串联，并结合Macaulay-Gotzmann理论与Ehresmann纤维化定理，把分析上有界性转化为微分同胚与拓扑类型的有限性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 极化Calabi-Yau流形的有限性问题（如微分同胚类型、拓扑类型的有限性）是复几何与代数几何中的核心问题，通常需要将分析上的度量/曲率一致控制与代数上的有界性联系起来。作者希望建立一条可逐步验证、能明确分辨瓶颈所在的统一路径，而非默认这些蕴含关系自动成立。

Method: 以全局\(m\)-Hessian容量作为复位势论与整体几何有界性之间的定量中介，构造一条一致估计链：\(m\)-Hessian容量→体积-容量不等式→容量-周长估计→Sobolev界→相关Ricci-flat Kähler度量的非塌缩；在适当正则性假设下由此得到一致直径与曲率控制，进而获得度量紧性。代数部分则通过一致有界次数的射影嵌入与Macaulay-Gotzmann理论，导出有限多个Hilbert多项式与有限个Hilbert概形，再用Ehresmann纤维化定理将光滑代数族的有界性转化为微分同胚与拓扑类型的有限性。

Result: 框架给出了从位势论估计到度量紧性、再到代数有界性和拓扑有限性的完整链条，并识别出主要瓶颈：容量-周长估计，以及从前述度量估计推导一致代数嵌入数据这两步是仍需进一步发展的关键环节。

Conclusion: 论文提供的是一个结构化的研究纲领，其价值在于把复Hessian位势论与几何、代数有界性明确连接，并指出可操作的技术突破口，而非宣称所有蕴含已自动成立。

Abstract: We propose a pluripotential-theoretic framework for studying finiteness questions for polarized Calabi--Yau manifolds. The central idea is to use global \(m\)-Hessian capacities as a quantitative intermediate between complex potential theory and global geometric boundedness. We formulate a chain of uniform estimates connecting \(m\)-Hessian capacity, volume--capacity inequalities, capacity--perimeter estimates, Sobolev bounds, and non-collapsing of the associated Ricci-flat Kähler metrics. Under suitable regularity assumptions, these estimates lead to uniform diameter and curvature control and hence to metric compactness. We then describe the algebraic part of the argument. Uniform projective embeddings with bounded degree lead, through the Macaulay--Gotzmann theory, to only finitely many possible Hilbert polynomials and hence to a finite collection of Hilbert schemes. Ehresmann's fibration theorem then converts boundedness of the smooth algebraic families into finiteness of diffeomorphism and topological types. The resulting framework isolates the main analytic and algebraic bottlenecks in a potential-theoretic approach to Calabi--Yau finiteness. In particular, the capacity--perimeter estimate and the derivation of uniform algebraic embedding data from the preceding metric estimates constitute the essential steps requiring further development. Thus the paper provides a structured program linking complex Hessian potential theory with geometric and algebraic boundedness, rather than assuming that these implications are automatic.

</details>


### [335] [Stratification of Joint Moduli Spaces of Higgs Bundles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00378)
*Shiyu Cao*

Main category: math.AG

TL;DR: 研究Teichmüller空间上零次SL_r(C)-Higgs丛的带标记解析模空间，证明全行列式为1稳定子的轨道型轨迹构成复Whitney分层，各层带相对全纯辛形式，由此在约化结构层上定义垂直全纯Poisson括号，并在每纤维上通过Hitchin–Kobayashi对应识别超Kähler结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 模空间的奇点结构（轨道型轨迹）在几何与表示论中具有重要性，但对其在Teichmüller空间上的解析分层、辛/Poisson结构及超Kähler性质缺乏系统性刻画；本文旨在建立带标记情形的精细分层几何与辛几何框架。

Method: 取Teichmüller空间上polystable零次SL_r(C)-Higgs丛的带标记解析模空间；以全行列式为1的稳定子定义的轨道型轨迹的连通分支构造复Whitney分层；在每个层上讨论投影的全纯淹没性并构造典范相对全纯辛形式；由此在约化结构层上定义垂直全纯Poisson括号；在纤维上应用Hitchin–Kobayashi对应与调和代表/垂直超Kähler张量。

Result: 轨道型轨迹的连通分支构成复Whitney分层；到Teichmüller空间的投影在每个层上是全纯淹没；每层带典范相对全纯辛形式并诱导约化结构层上的垂直全纯Poisson括号，其辛叶恰为纤维内连通轨道型层；在每纤维上Hitchin–Kobayashi对应在每个层上是双全纯并识别其超Kähler结构；调和代表与垂直超Kähler张量沿全空间的层光滑变化。

Conclusion: 该工作给出了带标记解析模空间的轨道型分层几何与相对辛/Poisson结构，并将纤维上的超Kähler识别与光滑依赖性统一起来，为研究模空间奇点及其辛几何和超Kähler几何提供了框架。

Abstract: We study the marked analytic moduli space of polystable degree-zero $\mathrm{SL}_r(\C)$-Higgs bundles over Teichmüller space. The connected components of the orbit-type loci defined by the full determinant-one stabilizers form a complex Whitney stratification. The projection to Teichmüller space is a holomorphic submersion on every stratum. Each stratum carries a canonical relative holomorphic symplectic form. These forms determine a vertical holomorphic Poisson bracket on the reduced structure sheaf, whose symplectic leaves are the connected orbit-type strata in the fibers. On each fiber, the Hitchin--Kobayashi correspondence is biholomorphic on every stratum and identifies its hyperkähler structure. The harmonic representatives and vertical hyperkähler tensors vary smoothly along the strata of the total space.

</details>


### [336] [Automorphisms of hypersurfaces in polarized varieties](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00709)
*Ana Quedo*

Main category: math.AG

TL;DR: 本文建立了判定超曲面自同构是否为背景簇自同构之限制的统一判据，用截面环的分次Betti数表述，推广了Matsumura-Monsky经典结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典Matsumura-Monsky结果刻画了射影空间中超曲面自同构向其背景射影空间自同构的扩张，但该结论局限于射影空间。作者希望将这一现象推广到更一般的极化簇(F,H)。

Method: 设F为射影簇，H为正规生成线丛，X∈|H^{⊗d}|为一般射影簇。以截面环R(F,H)的分次Betti数为核心工具，构造一个统一判据，给出X的每个自同构都能扩张为F的自同构的充分条件。

Result: 该判据适用于Picard数为1的有理齐性簇、带反典范极化的光滑Fano三维簇，以及若干超Kähler与Calabi-Yau簇的例子，验证了判据在更广极化簇类中的有效性。

Conclusion: 通过把自同构扩张问题转化为截面环分次Betti数的条件，作者得到统一且可验证的判据，显著扩展了Matsumura-Monsky定理的适用范围。

Abstract: Let $F$ be a projective variety, let $H$ be a normally generated line bundle on $F$, and let $X\in |H^{\otimes d}|$ be a general projective variety. We establish a uniform criterion, formulated in terms of the graded Betti numbers of the section ring $R(F,H)$, that provides sufficient conditions for every automorphism of $X$ to extend to an automorphism of $F$. This extends the classical results of Matsumura-Monsky on automorphisms of hypersurfaces in projective spaces to a broader class of polarized varieties $(F,H)$, including rational homogeneous varieties of Picard number one, smooth Fano threefolds with their anticanonical polarization, and examples of hyperkähler and Calabi-Yau varieties.

</details>


### [337] [Verdier-Type Category, Geometric Serre's conditions and perversity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01146)
*Shang Xu*

Main category: math.AG

TL;DR: 本文将 Serre 关于凝聚层的条件推广到带有 t-结构与对偶的三角范畴（Verdier 型范畴），并在可构造层情形下研究几何 Serre 条件，证明了几何版本的 Auslander-Reiten 猜想。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典 Serre 条件在凝聚层与交换代数中刻画了正则性等重要性质，但缺乏在三角范畴框架下的统一定义。本文旨在将这一概念推广到 Verdier 型范畴，并探索其在可构造层与 perversity 理论中的几何意义，同时寻求 Auslander-Reiten 猜想在几何情境下的对应版本。

Method: 作者对带有 t-结构与对偶的三角范畴（Verdier 型范畴）给出 Serre 条件的推广定义，构造并列举此类范畴的实例及其 Serre 条件；随后将理论应用于可构造层，定义几何 Serre 条件，并分析其与 perversity 之间的关系，通过一系列例子进行说明；最后据此证明几何版本的 Auslander-Reiten 猜想。

Result: 建立了 Verdier 型范畴上的 Serre 条件理论框架，给出了若干实例，刻画了几何 Serre 条件与 perversity 之间的关系，并通过例子加以验证；最终得到几何版本的 Auslander-Reiten 猜测。

Conclusion: Serre 条件可以自然推广至 Verdier 型范畴，并产生具有几何内涵的几何 Serre 条件；该框架不仅统一了相关理论，还导出了 Auslander-Reiten 猜想的几何实现。

Abstract: We generalize Serre's conditions for coherent sheaves to triangulated categories equipped with a $t$-structure and duality, which we call Verdier-type categories. We present examples of such categories and their associated Serre conditions, then focus on constructible sheaves, where we refer to these conditions as geometric Serre conditions. We investigate their relationship with perversity and illustrate the theory through a range of examples. Finally, we prove a geometric version of the Auslander-Reiten conjecture.

</details>


### [338] [An elliptic Calabi-Yau threefold of Mordell-Weil rank twelve](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01276)
*Dominik Burek*

Main category: math.AG

TL;DR: 该文构造了一个Hodge数为(25,1)、具有Mordell-Weil秩12的平坦椭圆纤维化 Calabi-Yau 三维体，并给出其显式双有理模型与射影crepant解消。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 寻求具有高Mordell-Weil秩、极端Hodge数（(25,1)）的Calabi-Yau三维体，这类对象是椭圆纤维化与弦论/模形式研究中的重要构造。

Method: 从固定椭圆曲线与 level-four 模族之积对应的 Kummer 曲面出发构造三维体；该三维体双有理等价于 $\mathbb{P}(\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1}(3)^{\oplus2}\oplus\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1}(4)\oplus\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1})$ 中的反规范四次超曲面。

Result: 得到光滑射影 Calabi-Yau 三维体，具有平坦椭圆纤维化、Mordell-Weil 秩12、Hodge数 $(h^{1,1},h^{2,1})=(25,1)$；给出12个独立截面，并构造相关 Weierstrass 模的射影 crepant 解消。

Conclusion: 构造了一个高 Mordell-Weil 秩且 Hodge 数极端的 Calabi-Yau 三维体，并给出其显式几何模型与解消，拓展了高秩椭圆纤维化 Calabi-Yau 三维体的构造。

Abstract: We construct a smooth projective Calabi--Yau threefold with a flat elliptic fibration of Mordell--Weil rank twelve and Hodge numbers $(h^{1,1},h^{2,1})=(25,1)$. The construction starts from the Kummer surfaces associated with the products of a fixed elliptic curve and the level-four modular family. The threefold is birational to an anticanonical quartic in $\mathbb{P}(\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1}(3)^{\oplus2}\oplus\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1}(4)\oplus\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1})$. We give twelve independent sections and construct a projective crepant resolution of the associated Weierstrass model.

</details>


### [339] [Abeloid varieties over higher rank valued fields: Raynaud uniformization and Néron models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01354)
*Simon Kaib,Annette Werner*

Main category: math.AG

TL;DR: 本文将 Raynaud 一致化推广到任意秩赋值环上的 adic 空间，并证明高阶秩赋值环上半阿贝尔簇的 Néron 模型存在性，进而得到 abeloid 簇的形式带标记 Néron 模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典 Raynaud 一致化与 Néron 模型理论主要针对秩一非阿基米德域或低秩赋值环。作者希望把这些结果推广到赋值环秩任意的 adic 空间情形，从而在更一般的非阿基米德几何框架下统一处理 abeloid 簇的形式模型与一致化问题。

Method: 在 $\operatorname{Spa}(K, K^+)$（$K$ 完备非阿基米德域，$K^+$ 任意秩赋值环）上研究 abeloid 簇。将 Raynaud 一致化推广到该高阶秩设定；利用代数与形式几何方法，对半阿贝尔簇构造 lft-Néron 模型，条件为赋值环分式域代数闭，或在完备秩一赋值环且剩余域代数闭时经有限可分基变换成立。在此基础上构造 abeloid 簇的形式带标记 Néron 模型，并分析高阶秩 Raynaud 扩张与形式 Néron 模型之间的联系。

Result: 建立了任意秩赋值环上的 Raynaud 一致化；证明了分式域代数闭的赋值环上半阿贝尔簇的代数 lft-Néron 模型存在性，以及在完备秩一赋值环、剩余域代数闭情形下经有限可分基变换后的存在性；进一步得到 $\operatorname{Spa}(K, K^+)$ 上 abeloid 簇经有限可分基变换后的形式带标记 Néron 模型，并刻画了高阶秩 Raynaud 扩张与形式 Néron 模型的关系。

Conclusion: 该工作将 Raynaud 一致化与 Néron 模型理论系统推广到任意秩赋值环的 adic 空间框架，给出高阶秩下 abeloid 簇的形式模型存在性，并揭示一致化与形式 Néron 模型之间的对应关系，为高阶秩非阿基米德几何中的模型理论提供了基础。

Abstract: We study abeloid varieties over the adic space $\operatorname{Spa}(K, K^+)$, where $K$ is a complete non-Archimedean field and $K^+$ is a valuation ring of arbitrary rank. We extend the well-known Raynaud uniformization to this setting. We also show the existence of suitable Néron models in algebraic and formal situations over higher rank valuation rings: We prove the existence of algebraic (lft-)Néron models for semi-abelian varieties over valuation rings with algebraically closed fraction fields, as well as, up to finite separable base change, over complete rank one valuation rings with algebraically closed residue field. Building on this result, we show the existence of formal marked Néron models for abeloid varieties over $\operatorname{Spa}(K, K^+)$ after finite separable base change. We also investigate the connection between the higher rank Raynaud extension and the formal Néron model.

</details>


### [340] [Stability of representation cohomology sheaves on moduli spaces of bundles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01481)
*Jianping Wang,Xueqing Wen*

Main category: math.AG

TL;DR: 本文证明光滑射影曲线（亏格 g≥2）上 SU_C(n,L) 的切层是斜率稳定的，并将结果推广到连通约化群主丛模空间上的稳定性定理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究模空间上自然向量丛（如切层及其推广的表示关联上同调层）的稳定性，是代数几何中刻画模空间几何性质的重要问题，但此前对 SU_C(n,L) 及主丛模空间的切层稳定性缺乏一般性结论，尤其在模空间可能奇异、需对任意极化成立的情形下。

Method: 对任意亏格 g≥2 的光滑复射影曲线 C、任意 n≥2 与任意行列式 L，证明 SU_C(n,L) 的切层斜率稳定；对 g≥3，利用与表示关联的上同调层替代切层，证明连通约化群主丛模空间上更一般的稳定性定理；对几乎单群情形，通过伴随表示得到切层稳定性；稳定性对任意 ample Cartier 极化成立，且不要求模空间光滑。

Result: 证明了 SU_C(n,L) 切层的斜率稳定性（g≥2）；在 g≥3 时建立了连通约化群主丛模空间上基于表示关联上同调层的一般稳定性定理，并通过伴随表示导出几乎单群情形切层的稳定性；结果对可能奇异的模空间及任意 ample Cartier 极化均成立。

Conclusion: 该工作统一并推广了模空间切层稳定性结果：从 SU_C(n,L) 情形扩展到连通约化群主丛模空间，用表示关联上同调层替代切层，并在模空间奇异与任意极化条件下仍保持稳定。

Abstract: We prove that the tangent sheaf of $\SU_C(n,L)$ is slope stable for every smooth complex projective curve $C$ of genus $g\geq2$, every $n\geq2$, and every determinant $L$. For $g\geq3$, we prove a more general stability theorem on moduli spaces of principal bundles for connected reductive groups, using cohomology sheaves associated with representations in place of tangent sheaves. The adjoint representation gives tangent sheaf stability for the case of almost simple groups. The moduli spaces may be singular, and stability holds with respect to every ample Cartier polarization.

</details>


### [341] [An explicit form of the standard conjecture of Hodge type for Hermitian varieties, with $p$-adic applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01731)
*Shushi Harashita*

Main category: math.AG

TL;DR: 本文给出Hermitian簇middle cohomology上相交形式正定性的初等证明，避免有限酉群表示论，且控制格的p进性质。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Dummigan、Dummigan-Tiep及Shimada已证明Hermitian簇中极大全迷向子空间类张成中间上同调且本原部分相交形式正定，但依赖有限酉群表示论。作者希望给出更初等、可p进控制的证明。

Method: 利用Hermitian形式对应的对极图（dual polar graph），不借助有限酉群表示论，证明本原部分相交形式为某Euclidean内积的显式正倍数；并分析相交矩阵的p进初等因子。

Result: 对F_{q^2}上2m维X，相交矩阵每个p进初等因子整除q^m；因此q^m乘任意余维m代数循环数值等价于这些子空间的整系数组合。Hodge型标准猜想对Hermitian簇的有限覆盖成立，p进界沿次数与p互素的有限态射下降。

Conclusion: 新证明不仅简化了正定性证明，还提供了p进控制，推广了Hodge型标准猜想的适用范围。

Abstract: Let $X$ be a nonsingular Hermitian variety of even dimension over a finite field, and let $Λ$ be the lattice spanned by the classes of its maximal totally isotropic linear subspaces defined over the base field. By work of Dummigan, Dummigan--Tiep and Shimada, these classes span the middle cohomology, and the intersection form on the primitive part is definite, as predicted by the standard conjecture of Hodge type. We give an elementary proof, which avoids the representation theory of finite unitary groups and uses only the dual polar graph attached to the Hermitian form. It shows that the intersection form on the primitive part is an explicit positive multiple of a Euclidean inner product.
  The advantage of the new proof is that it also controls $Λ$ $p$-adically. If $X$ is defined over $\F_{q^2}$ and has dimension $2m$, every $p$-adic elementary divisor of the intersection matrix of these subspaces divides $q^m$. Consequently $q^m$ times every algebraic cycle of codimension $m$ is numerically equivalent to an integral combination of them. As a by-product, the standard conjecture of Hodge type holds for varieties finitely covered by Hermitian varieties, and the $p$-adic bound descends along finite morphisms of degree prime to $p$.

</details>


### [342] [Dihedral reflections and an infinite series of irrational Seshadri constants](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01783)
*Grzegorz Malara,Łukasz Merta,Justyna Szpond,Marcin Zieliński*

Main category: math.AG

TL;DR: 将Laface–Ugaglia的一个不可有理Seshadri常数构造机制统一推广到所有奇数n≥5，给出显式丰沛除子及一类平衡反射原理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Laface与Ugaglia此前仅在P²沿九个很一般点爆破的情形构造出无理的单点Seshadri常数，其机制依赖于P¹×P¹上的二面体轨道、de Jonquières变换序列以及沿(-4)-曲线的反射。本文旨在说明该机制并非偶发特例，而可统一推广至所有奇数n≥5，并提炼其背后的抽象原理。

Method: 对n=2k+1，考虑P¹×P¹上除子O(n-4,1)在2n个很一般点处的单点Seshadri常数，并在固定2n阶二面体群的很一般自由轨道上直接计算。构造结合二面体轨道、de Jonquières变换与沿带平衡法丛的(-4)-曲线反射；经一次二次变换后得到P²爆破上的显式除子L_n。进一步抽象出"平衡反射原理"：当有理曲线法丛为O(-a)^{⊕2}时可沿其反射特殊纤维上的nef类，且反射类在很一般纤维上仍为nef。

Result: 证明 ε(O_{P¹×P¹}(n-4,1); p_1,…,p_{2n}) = √((n-4)/n)，在2n个很一般点处成立，且仅在固定2n阶二面体群的一个很一般自由轨道上即成立。对每个奇数n≥7，在P²沿k+7=(n+13)/2个很一般点爆破上给出显式丰沛线丛，其在很一般点处的单点Seshadri常数为2√(n(n-4))；经一次二次变换后该除子为 L_n=(3n-4)H-nE_1-(n-2)(E_2+…+E_5)-4(E_6+…+E_{k+5})-2(E_{k+6}+E_{k+7})，满足 L_n²=4n(n-4) 且 ε(L_n;x)=√(L_n²)。

Conclusion: 该机制可统一推广：对所有奇数n≥5，O(n-4,1)在很一般点（甚至单个二面体自由轨道）上的单点Seshadri常数具有上述闭形式；对n≥7给出P²爆破上的显式丰沛除子，使Seshadri常数等于除子自交的平方根，并推广了Laface–Ugaglia的无理Seshadri常数构造，同时提炼出平衡反射原理作为更一般的构造工具。

Abstract: Laface and Ugaglia recently constructed an irrational one-point Seshadri constant on the blow-up of $\mathbb{P}^2$ at nine very general points by combining a dihedral orbit on $\mathbb{P}^1\times\mathbb{P}^1$, a sequence of de Jonquières transformations, and a reflection argument along a $(-4)$-curve with balanced normal bundle. We show that the same mechanism extends uniformly to every odd integer $n\geq 5$. For $n=2k+1$ we prove $$ \varepsilon\bigl(\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1\times\mathbb{P}^1}(n-4,1);p_1,\ldots,p_{2n}\bigr)=\sqrt{\frac{n-4}{n}} $$ at $2n$ very general points, and already at a very general free orbit of a fixed dihedral group of order $2n$. For every odd $n\geq 7$ this produces an explicit ample line bundle on the blow-up of $\mathbb{P}^2$ at $k+7=(n+13)/2$ very general points whose one-point Seshadri constant at a very general point equals $$ 2\sqrt{n(n-4)}. $$ More precisely, after one quadratic transformation we obtain the ample divisor $$ L_n=(3n-4)H-nE_1-(n-2)(E_2+\cdots+E_5)-4(E_6+\cdots+E_{k+5})-2(E_{k+6}+E_{k+7}), $$ with $L_n^2=4n(n-4)$ and $\varepsilon(L_n;x)=\sqrt{L_n^2}$. We also isolate an abstract balanced-reflection principle underlying the construction: a nef class on a special fiber can be reflected across a rational curve of square $-2a$ whenever the curve has normal bundle $\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}^1}(-a)^{\oplus 2}$ in the total space, and the reflected class is nef on very general fibers.

</details>


### [343] [Cohomology of the fine compactified universal Jacobians $\overline{J}_2$ and $\overline{J}_{2,1}$](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01829)
*Marco Fava*

Main category: math.AG

TL;DR: 计算了亏格2、0个和1个标记点的稳定曲线模空间上紧化通用雅可比簇的有理上同调。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 曲线模空间及其上自然定义的代数簇的上同调是代数几何的核心研究对象；对于型模空间（细紧化通用雅可比簇）有理上同调的具体计算，在低亏格情形仍缺乏明确结果，是该方向值得补齐的基础性计算。

Method: 以稳定曲线模空间（亏格2，0与1个标记点）为底，取其细紧化通用雅可比簇，通过代数几何与上同调代数技术直接计算其有理系数奇异或de Rham上同调。

Result: 给出了亏格2、标记数为0和1时细紧化通用雅可比簇的有理上同调（具体分次模结构）。

Conclusion: 完成了低亏格（g=2，n=0,1）细紧化通用雅可比簇有理上同调的计算，为更一般亏格与标记数情形提供验证与参照。

Abstract: We compute the rational cohomology of the fine compactified universal Jacobians over the moduli spaces of stable curves of genus $2$ with $0$ and $1$ marked points.

</details>


### [344] [Euclidean Distance Optimization Within the Grassmannian](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02018)
*Hannah Friedman,Serkan Hoşten,Andrea Rosana*

Main category: math.AG

TL;DR: 本文研究Grassmannian子簇上最近点问题的代数复杂度，证明整个Grassmannian的ED判别式等于数据作为投影矩阵的特征多项式判别式，并给出若干几何有意义子簇的ED与GD次数公式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Grassmannian子簇上的欧氏距离优化问题的临界点数目（ED次数）及其退化判别式是重要的代数复杂度度量，但对整个Grassmannian的ED判别式结构以及具体子簇的ED/GD次数尚缺乏明确刻画与公式。

Method: 将数据点视为投影矩阵，利用其特征多项式的判别式刻画整个Grassmannian的ED判别式；引入Grassmann距离（GD）次数（数据点落在Grassmannian内时的临界点数），并针对乘积子簇、拟阵实现簇与Schubert簇等子簇推导ED与GD次数的公式。

Result: 证明了整个Grassmannian的ED判别式恰为数据作为投影矩阵的特征多项式的判别式；给出了乘积型子Grassmannian、拟阵实现簇及Schubert簇的ED次数与GD次数的显式公式。

Conclusion: 该工作将Grassmannian上最近点问题的临界点计数与投影矩阵特征多项式判别式联系起来，并为多类几何意义明确的子簇提供了ED与GD次数的计算工具，推进了对这些代数复杂度度量的理解。

Abstract: Given a subvariety of the Grassmannian and a data point, we seek to find a point on the subvariety minimizing the Euclidean distance to the data point. The number of complex critical points of this optimization problem is the Euclidean distance (ED) degree. We show that the ED discriminant of the whole Grassmannian, that is, the set of data points with a number of critical points different than the ED degree, is the discriminant of the characteristic polynomial of the data as a projection matrix. Another closely connected algebraic complexity measure for a subvariety in the Grassmannian is the Grassmann distance (GD) degree, which is the number of complex critical points of the distance optimization problem when the data point itself is in the Grassmannian. We give formulae for ED and GD degrees of geometrically meaningful subvarieties of the Grassmannian, namely, products of smaller Grassmannians, matroid realization varieties, and Schubert varieties.

</details>


### [345] [Quasi-modularity of $q$-traces and integrals over Hilbert schemes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02049)
*Killian Hong-Minh,Sergey Mozgovoy*

Main category: math.AG

TL;DR: 在有限维二次空间及超空间对应的玻色Fock空间上，证明自由玻色场及其后代算子归一化q-迹的准模性，权有上界，并给出多个应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究玻色Fock空间上q-迹的准模性是量子场论、顶点算子代数与代数几何中交叉的核心问题，尤其与Qin关于Hilbert概型的准模性猜想以及Bloch--Okounkov准模性定理密切相关。

Method: 在有限维二次空间及其超空间关联的玻色Fock空间上，对由自由玻色场及其后代生成的一类自然算子，考察其归一化q-迹，并证明其准模性且权被插入算子权之和所界定。

Result: 证明该类算子的归一化q-迹具有准模性，权由插入权之和控制；作为应用，证明Qin关于数值平凡典范类曲面Hilbert概型上tautological积分的准模性猜想，得到Heisenberg顶点算子代数中任意零模关联函数的准模性，并给出Bloch--Okounkov准模性定理的新证明（作为秩一特化）。

Conclusion: 结果统一并推广了若干已知准模性结论，为相关猜想提供了新证明，并揭示秩一情形与一般玻色Fock空间框架之间的联系。

Abstract: We study quasi-modularity of normalized $q$-traces on bosonic Fock spaces associated with finite-dimensional quadratic spaces and superspaces. For a natural class of operators obtained from free-boson fields and their descendants, we prove that their normalized $q$-traces are quasi-modular, with weight bounded by the sum of the weights of the insertions. As applications, we prove Qin's quasi-modularity conjecture for tautological integrals on Hilbert schemes of points of a surface with numerically trivial canonical class, obtain quasi-modularity of arbitrary zero-mode correlation functions in the Heisenberg vertex operator algebra, and give a new proof of the Bloch--Okounkov quasi-modularity theorem as a rank-one specialization of our general result.

</details>


### [346] [GW/PT-correspondence for CY 4-folds-I: Canonical Orientations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02061)
*Ivan Karpov*

Main category: math.AG

TL;DR: 该文构建了非紧复解析 Calabi-Yau 4-流形模叠上朝向的拓扑理论，得到 PT 对模空间的标准族朝向，服务于 4 维 GW/PT 对应证明。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为在 4 维实现 Pardon 纲领、证明 Calabi-Yau 4-流形的 GW/PT 对应，需要为相关模空间建立一致的朝向（orientation）理论。

Method: 推广并扩展 Joyce-Upmeier 与 Bojko 的工作，利用表示 KU- 与 KO- 理论的映射空间的代数拓扑，以及 Lie 群 E8 和 HSpin(16) 的若干性质。

Result: 建立非紧复解析 Calabi-Yau 4-流形模叠上朝向的连贯拓扑理论；特别地，得到所有 Pandharipande-Thomas 对模空间的标准族朝向。

Conclusion: 该朝向理论为 4 维 GW/PT 对应证明提供关键工具，是作者与 Felix Thimm 合作项目的一部分。

Abstract: We build a cohesive topological theory of orientations on moduli stacks for non-compact complex-analytic Calabi-Yau $4$-folds by extending and generalising the work of Joyce and Upmeier, and the work of Bojko. As a result, we get, in particular, canonical family orientations for all moduli spaces of Pandharipande-Thomas pairs. Our proofs use the algebraic topology of mapping spaces representing $KU$- and $KO$- theory, as well as some properties of the Lie groups $E_8$ and, surprisingly, $\operatorname{HSpin}(16)$.
  This is part of a joint project with Felix Thimm dedicated to the proof of the $GW/PT$-correspondence for Calabi-Yau $4$-folds by implementing Pardon's programme in dimension $4$.

</details>


### [347] [The Nash manifold of four-point configurations modulo similarity subgroups](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02087)
*Bruce Olberding,Elaine A. Walker*

Main category: math.AG

TL;DR: 本文用"四边形"代替四点构型，构造并研究实平面中四点构型在相似变换的Nash子群作用下的Nash模空间，证明四边形空间为8维Nash流形且其轨道空间为Nash流形，并引入"aspect"几何不变量将非例外部分约化为两个模型纤维。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典的四点构型模空间在退化情形下会丢失极限直线信息，导致模空间结构不完整。作者希望用更精细的"四边形"概念保留退化时的直线数据，从而在Nash（实代数）范畴下完整刻画模空间结构。

Method: 1) 以"四边形"取代"四点构型"以保留退化直线数据；2) 在实平面上构造四边形空间Q，并研究其在相似变换群的Nash子群G作用下的轨道空间Q/G；3) 定义取值于[-1,1]的几何不变量"aspect"；4) 在区间(-1,0)和(0,1)上分析Q/G的结构。

Result: 证明四边形空间Q是8维Nash流形；对相似群的任意Nash子群G，轨道空间Q/G是Nash流形；在区间(-1,0)和(0,1)上，Q/G的对应部分Nash微分同胚于该区间与固定纤维的乘积，从而非例外部分的模问题约化为两个模型纤维的分析，每个纤维都有四边形的自然几何解释。

Conclusion: 通过引入四边形和aspect不变量，非例外部分的模空间被完全约化为两个具有自然几何意义的模型纤维，为四点构型模问题提供了清晰的Nash几何结构刻画。

Abstract: We construct and study the Nash manifold of four-point configurations in the real plane modulo the action of a Nash subgroup of the group of similarity transformations. We do so by using the finer notion of a quadrangle in place of that of a four-point configuration, since this retains limiting line data in degenerations. We prove that the space ${\mathcal Q}$ of quadrangles is an 8-dimensional Nash manifold and that, for every Nash subgroup $G$ of the similarity group, the orbit space ${\mathcal Q}/G$ is a Nash manifold. We define a geometric invariant, called aspect, with values in $[-1,1]$, and prove that, over each of the intervals $(-1,0)$ and $(0,1)$, the corresponding part of ${\mathcal Q}/G$ is Nash diffeomorphic to the product of the interval with a fixed fiber. Thus the nonexceptional part of the moduli problem reduces to the analysis of two model fibers, each having a natural geometric interpretation in terms of the quadrangles themselves.

</details>


### [348] [Higher-Page Jacobian and Albanese Tori](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02109)
*Dan Popovici,Luis Ugarte*

Main category: math.AG

TL;DR: 本文用Hodge理论方法，为页-(r-1)-∂∂̄及E_r-sGG紧复流形构造E_r-Jacobian环面、E_r-Albanese环面与映射，并给出结构定理及代数维数恒等式；应用于S^6的复结构情形，证否强Gauduchon度量的存在性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期引入的页-(r-1)-∂∂̄流形与E_r-sGG流形两类紧复流形（前者包含于后者）缺乏相应的Hodge理论与Albanese型不变量，需要建立统一框架以刻画其几何与代数结构，并借以研究S^6上复结构的相关度量与上同调性质。

Method: 采用Hodge理论方法：对新引入的E_r-sGG流形发展Hodge理论，据此构造任意页-(r-1)-∂∂̄或E_r-sGG紧复流形的E_r-Jacobian环面、E_r-Albanese环面及E_r-Albanese映射，并推导结构定理与代数维数恒等式。

Result: 建立了E_r-sGG流形的Hodge理论；构造出E_r-Jacobian环面、E_r-Albanese环面与映射；给出结构定理以及用E_r-Albanese映射与环面表达的代数维数恒等式；对六维球面S^6，在假设复结构或文献声称存在的复结构下得到上同调与度量定理，特别地证明后一情形下S^6上不存在强Gauduchon度量。

Conclusion: E_r-Albanese理论为页-(r-1)-∂∂̄与E_r-sGG紧复流形提供了有效的Hodge理论工具，揭示其结构与代数维数信息；该框架对S^6复结构的度量与上同调约束给出了具体否定性结论，如强Gauduchon度量的不存在。

Abstract: We construct, through Hodge-theoretical methods, what we call the $E_r$-Jacobian torus, the $E_r$-Albanese torus and the $E_r$-Albanese map of any compact complex manifold that is either {\it page-(r-1)-$\partial\bar\partial$} or {\it $E_r$-sGG}. These two classes of manifolds, the former of which is contained in the latter, have been introduced recently by both authors jointly with J. Stelzig, respectively by the first-named author. A Hodge theory is also developed for the latter class of manifolds. We then apply our results to give structure theorems and an identity of algebraic dimensions in terms of the $E_r$-Albanese map and torus. Other applications result in cohomological and metrical theorems for the $6$-dimensional sphere when it is equipped either with a hypothetical complex structure or with the complex structures very recently claimed to exist in the literature. For example, we show that in the latter case no {\it strongly Gauduchon} metric exists on $S^6$.

</details>
