### [349] [A relaxation system for the low-Mach limit of kinetic equations: Stability and higher order asymptotic preserving scheme](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00811)
*Giacomo Dimarco,Axel Klar,Theresa Köfler,Lorenzo Pareschi,Sudarshan Tiwari,Yizhou Zhou*

Main category: math.NA

TL;DR: 本文提出一种双曲松弛（relaxation）系统，用于低马赫数极限下动理学方程的模拟，并配套开发了高精度渐近保持（AP）数值格式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 动理学方程在低马赫数（近不可压缩）极限下存在刚性、尺度分离等挑战，传统数值方法难以在不同物理区制下保持一致性与稳定，且计算成本高。作者希望构建一个既能捕捉不可压缩极限、又可高效求解的松弛模型与数值框架。

Method: 对尺度化BGK模型作微-宏分解（micro-macro decomposition），将分布函数拆分为宏观平衡部分与微观非平衡余项；将微观偏差投影到正交多项式基底，得到封闭的矩松弛系统。该系统本质为带线性双曲主部、且松弛项适配不可压缩极限的Grad 13矩系统。数值上采用IMEX Runge-Kutta格式保证时间高阶精度，空间上使用有限差分WENO重构与中心差分格式获得高阶分辨率。

Result: 证明了模型在不可压缩Navier-Stokes极限下的结构稳定性；所提AP格式在不同物理区制下具有一致稳定性与相容性，当尺度参数趋于零时自动退化为不可压缩热Navier-Stokes极限的一致高阶离散。一维与二维数值实验验证了理论结果，显示计算成本显著降低，并在广泛的Knudsen数与Mach数范围内表现稳健。

Conclusion: 所构建的双曲松弛系统及高阶AP-IMEX数值框架可有效、稳健地模拟低马赫数极限下的动理学方程，具备渐近保持性质与良好计算效率，适用于跨区制多尺度流动问题。

Abstract: This work introduces a hyperbolic relaxation system designed for the simulation of kinetic equations in the low-Mach number limit. The methodology is built upon a micro-macro decomposition of the scaled BGK model, which reformulates the kinetic distribution function into a coupled system consisting of a macroscopic equilibrium part and a microscopic non-equilibrium remainder. By projecting the microscopic deviations onto a set of orthogonal polynomials, we derive a closed moment relaxation system. The resulting system is a version of Grad's 13 moment system with a linear hyperbolic part and a relaxation adapted to the incompressible limit. We prove the model's structural stability in the incompressible Navier-Stokes limit. Moreover, we develop a high order Asymptotic-Preserving (AP) numerical framework using Implicit-Explicit (IMEX) Runge Kutta schemes for temporal accuracy and finite difference WENO reconstructions as well as central difference approximations for high order spatial resolution. The proposed scheme ensures uniform stability and consistency across different physical regimes, automatically degenerating into a consistent high order discretization of the incompressible thermal Navier-Stokes limit as the scaling parameter vanishes. Numerical experiments in one and two dimensions corroborate the theoretical findings, demonstrating significant reductions in computational cost and robust performance across a wide range of Knudsen and Mach numbers.

</details>


### [350] [Matrix-Free Moment-Matching Method for Reduced-Order Modeling of Quadratic-Bilinear Descriptor Systems with Multiple Inputs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00830)
*Zeyuan Gao,Cheol W. Lee,Oleg Zikanov*

Main category: math.NA

TL;DR: 提出一种面向多输入二次-双线性描述系统的新矩匹配降阶方法，支持多输入分别作用于微分与代数方程，采用无矩阵算法避免显式组装全阶矩阵与张量，适用于大规模CFD问题，二维流动实验验证了降阶模型在多时变输入下能准确复现全阶瞬态响应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多输入二次-双线性描述系统的降阶需求，尤其是输入同时作用于微分方程和代数方程的场景；大规模计算流体力学问题中全阶矩阵/张量难以显式组装或存储，需要无矩阵的降阶手段。

Method: 基于矩匹配的降阶方法：针对不同输入通道及输入组合构造独立的投影空间；采用无矩阵算法，在不需要显式组装或存储全阶系统矩阵与张量的前提下计算降阶后的矩阵和张量。

Result: 在二维流动问题上的数值实验表明，所得降阶模型能够在多个时变输入下准确复现全阶模型的瞬态响应。

Conclusion: 该方法可有效处理多输入二次-双线性描述系统，并因无矩阵特性特别适合大规模计算流体力学问题，具有实际应用价值。

Abstract: This paper develops a new moment-matching order reduction method for multi-input quadratic-bilinear descriptor systems. The proposed approach accommodates multiple inputs acting on both the differential and algebraic equations and constructs separate projection spaces associated with different input channels and input combinations. The method uses a matrix-free algorithm, allowing the reduced-order matrices and tensors to be computed without explicitly assembling or storing the full-order system matrices and tensors. This feature makes the proposed method particularly suitable for large-scale computational fluid dynamics problems. Numerical experiments carried out for two-dimensional flow problems demonstrate that the resulting reduced-order models accurately reproduce the transient responses of the full-order models under multiple time-varying inputs.

</details>


### [351] [Uncertainty Quantification for Landweber Iteration with Randomized Normal-Operator Approximation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00882)
*Anuj Abhishek,Sean Holman*

Main category: math.NA

TL;DR: 本文研究线性不适定反问题中Landweber迭代的不确定性量化，以Radon变换为例，通过广义信仰推断将数据噪声传播到重建结果，结合正则化偏差上界构造置信区间，并利用随机SVD低秩近似降低计算成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 迭代方法广泛用于求解线性不适定反问题，其确定性收敛（半收敛）已被广泛研究，但由观测数据中随机噪声引起的重建不确定性量化问题关注甚少。需要在获得重建的同时给出可靠的不确定性估计。

Method: 将Landweber重建进行统计解释，分析测量数据的不确定性如何通过重建映射传播，该视角与广义信仰推断密切相关；将得到的随机不确定性与正则化偏差的理论上界结合，构造重建解的置信区间；为降低大规模问题中重复正算子运算的开销，采用随机SVD获得Radon变换相关正规算子的低秩近似，并将随机化引入的额外误差纳入不确定性量化框架。

Result: 数值结果表明，所提方法能提供准确的重建结果与可靠的不确定性估计，同时显著降低计算成本。

Conclusion: 所提框架可在可接受的计算代价下实现线性不适定反问题的不确定性量化，将随机化误差合理纳入置信区间构造是保证估计可靠性的关键。

Abstract: Iterative methods are extremely popular for solving linear ill-posed inverse problems. While deterministic convergence, or more precisely, semi-convergence of such methods is widely studied, the problem of quantifying uncertainty in the resulting reconstructions due to random noise in the observed data has received far less attention. In this work, we study uncertainty quantification for the Landweber iteration in linear inverse problems using the Radon transform as a motivating example. We interpret the Landweber reconstruction statistically by analyzing how uncertainty in the measured data is propagated through the reconstruction map. This perspective is closely related to generalized fiducial inference, where uncertainty about the parameter is induced by inverting the relation between the observed data and the unknown (fixed) quantity. We combine the resulting stochastic uncertainty with a theoretical bound on the regularization bias to construct confidence intervals for the reconstructed solution. The evaluation of the resulting uncertainty estimates require repeated operations with the forward operator that can become expensive in large-scale problems. To reduce this cost, we use randomized singular value decomposition to obtain a low-rank approximation of the normal operator associated with the Radon transform and incorporate this approximation in quantifying uncertainty. {In particular, this requires that the additional randomization error introduced due to the use of such randomized techniques be included in our approach for uncertainty quantification.} Numerical results show that the proposed method provides accurate reconstructions and reliable uncertainty estimates at substantially reduced computational cost.

</details>


### [352] [A Deferred Correction, Continuous Galerkin Method for Curvilinear Staggered-Grid Lagrangian Hydrodynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00932)
*Steven Walton,Svetlana Tokareva,Nathaniel Morgan*

Main category: math.NA

TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于拉格朗日流体力学方程的连续伽辽金-延迟修正(cG-DeC)方法，结合高阶连续有限元离散与显式DeC时间积分器，避免全局稀疏质量矩阵求逆；通过改进超粘性模型稳定强激波，并给出DeC迭代的递推重构及守恒性分析，数值实验验证其精度与鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 拉格朗日流体力学方程含强激波，传统高阶离散需每步求解全局稀疏质量矩阵，计算成本高。作者希望在保持高阶精度的同时避免全局求解，并构造兼容框架的激波稳定机制。

Method: 采用连续伽辽金(空间) + 显式延迟修正DeC(时间)组合格式，避免每次更新求逆全局稀疏质量矩阵；引入与cG-DeC框架兼容的超粘性模型修正，用于稳定强激波且构造多调和算子有限元逼近时无需全局求解；提出DeC迭代的替代重构，具有简单递推算法结构；对全离散格式进行动量与总能量守恒分析。

Result: 数值实验表明cG-DeC格式具有良好精度与鲁棒性；与连续伽辽金-龙格库塔(cG-RK)方法进行对比，验证所提格式的性能优势。重构的DeC迭代解释了显式DeC应用于双曲型偏微分方程时先前观察到的收敛行为。

Conclusion: cG-DeC方法为拉格朗日流体力学提供了一种无需全局质量矩阵求逆的高阶、守恒且激波鲁棒的离散方案，其DeC递推重构有助于理解显式DeC的收敛特性。

Abstract: We present a continuous Galerkin, Deferred Correction (cG-DeC) method for the equations of Lagrangian hydrodynamics. The proposed scheme combines a high-order continuous finite element discretization with an explicit Deferred Correction time integrator, yielding a formulation that avoids the inversion of a global sparse mass matrix at each update. To stabilize the method in the presence of strong shocks we introduce a modification of the hyperviscosity model that is compatible with the cG-DeC framework and likewise does not require a global solve to construct the finite element approximation to the polyharmonic operator. We further present an alternative reformulation of the DeC iteration which admits a simple recursive algorithmic structure and provides insight into previously observed convergence behavior of explicit DeC applied to hyperbolic partial differential equations. Conservation of momentum and total energy of the resulting fully discrete scheme is analyzed. A set of numerical experiments illustrates the accuracy and robustness of the cG-DeC scheme. Comparisons with a continuous Galerkin Runge-Kutta (cG-RK) method are provided.

</details>


### [353] [Positivity-preserving scalar auxiliary variable schemes for gradient flows via a quadratic reformulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01063)
*Qiong-Ao Huang,Zhi-Hao Liu,Ying-Wei Wang,Li-Na Yan*

Main category: math.NA

TL;DR: 本文指出SAV方法离散格式中r^{n+1}可能丧失正性,构造反例并给出时间步判别准则,进而通过对(r^2)_t重表述保留平方根形式,得到无条件能量稳定且保证唯一正根的格式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标量辅助变量(SAV)方法通过正标量r(t)=sqrt(E_N[φ]+C)将自由能非线性部分线性化,得到线性、无条件能量稳定的梯度流格式。但在离散层面,标准后向欧拉与Crank-Nicolson格式无法保证计算出的r^{n+1}保持正值,这与连续定义不符,违背平方根假设,可能损害长时间稳健性。该问题虽细微却后果重大,却鲜受关注。

Method: 首先定量刻画该失效:推导关于时间步长的紧致判别准则与充分条件,并构造显式反例说明在实际相关参数下会发生符号丧失。不同于既有保正变体修改r的定义,作者保留平方根形式,将离散演化从r_t重表述为(r^2)_t,把标量方程转化为常数项严格为负的凸二次方程,从而总有唯一正根。对Crank-Nicolson格式,乘积形式离散r^{n+1}r^n可保持该二次结构,而常规替代方案则不能。

Result: 所得格式计算成本与原SAV方法相同,并被证明无条件能量稳定。针对Cahn-Hilliard方程的数值实验验证了预测的正性、能量稳定性与收敛阶。

Conclusion: SAV方法离散层面r正性丧失是一个被忽视但重要的问题;通过将演化改写为(r^2)_t并使用乘积形式离散,可在不增加计算成本、不修改平方根定义的前提下保证唯一正根与无条件能量稳定性。

Abstract: The scalar auxiliary variable (SAV) method replaces the nonlinear part of the free energy by a positive scalar $r(t)=\sqrt{\mathcal{E}_{_\mathcal{N}}[φ]+C}>0$, thereby yielding linear, unconditionally energy-stable schemes for gradient flows. At the discrete level, however, the standard backward Euler and Crank--Nicolson discretizations provide no guarantee that the computed $r^{n+1}$ remains positive, an inconsistency with the continuous definition that contradicts the square-root ansatz and may compromise long-time robustness. Although the SAV method has been widely applied, this subtle but consequential issue has received little attention. We first characterize this failure quantitatively by deriving a sharp criterion and a sufficient condition on the time step size, and construct an explicit counterexample showing that sign loss occurs for parameters of practical relevance. Rather than modifying the definition of $r$ as in existing positivity-preserving variants, we retain the square-root form and reformulate the discrete evolution from $r_t$ to $(r^{2})_t$, which converts the scalar equation into a convex quadratic with a strictly negative constant term, always yielding a unique positive root. For the Crank--Nicolson scheme, the product-form discretization $r^{n+1}r^{n}$ preserves this quadratic structure, while conventional alternatives do not. The resulting schemes incur the same computational cost as the original SAV method and are proved unconditionally energy-stable. Numerical experiments for the Cahn--Hilliard equation confirm the predicted positivity, energy stability, and convergence rates.

</details>


### [354] [A higher order lattice-based method for high-dimensional numerical integration using periodization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01113)
*Felix Bartel,Alexander D. Gilbert,Michael Griebel,Frances Y. Kuo,Ian H. Sloan*

Main category: math.NA

TL;DR: 提出一种基于变换格点与（非等）加权求积规则的高维非周期函数数值积分方法，可用于被积函数混合导数（至 α 阶）关于乘积 Chebyshev 密度平方可积的情形。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对高维单位立方体上非周期函数的数值积分问题，利用格点求积与加权规则在可选子采样条件下提升高维积分效率。

Method: 三步：周期化被积函数；利用核插值在格点处近似光滑周期函数；对核插值与非光滑密度的乘积精确积分，并对插值与积分步骤提供子采样替代方案。

Result: 以 |J| 表示函数求值次数，收敛速率接近 |J|^{-(α-1/2)} 与 |J|^{-α}(1.110721)^s；在有利条件下隐含常数与维度 s 无关，并可在两种结果间插值以权衡收敛速率与维度增长。

Conclusion: 数值实验验证了理论结果，表明该方法在高维非周期积分中兼顾收敛速率与维度可扩展性。

Abstract: We present a novel numerical integration method for non-periodic functions over the high-dimensional unit cube $[0,1]^s$ by a specially crafted (unequally-)weighted quadrature rule using transformed lattice points, with the additional option of subsampling. The method is designed for integrands whose mixed derivatives up to order $α$ are square-integrable with respect to a product Chebyshev density. The ingredients are (i) periodizing the integrand, (ii) approximating the smooth periodic function by a kernel interpolant at lattice points, (iii) integrating exactly the product of the kernel interpolant and the nonsmooth density, together with subsampling alternatives for (ii) and~(iii). With $|J|$ corresponding to the number of function evaluations, we achieve the convergence rate close to the order $|J|^{-(α-1/2)}$ and $|J|^{-α}\,($1.110721$)^s$, where the implied constants are independent of $s$ under favorable conditions. We can interpolate these two results to trade between the convergence rate and the growth in $s$. We provide numerical experiments to demonstrate our theory.

</details>


### [355] [Sign-Switched Antithetic Coupling for Signed Gradient-Particle Methods](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01120)
*Stephen Abkin,Prabir Daripa*

Main category: math.NA

TL;DR: 本文将梯度随机游走模拟成对运行，提出符号切换配对（sign-switched pairing）以降低方差，并证明其在一维对流扩散方程中的最优性与推广性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 梯度随机游走方法用带符号粒子表示解的梯度并通过求和恢复解，但存在采样误差，需在保持单次模拟期望与偏差不变的前提下降低方差，从而减少达到给定均方误差所需的样本量。

Method: 让两次模拟按粒子位置顺序配对：反射配对（标准对偶选择）给匹配粒子相反位移；符号切换配对中，同号匹配粒子给相反位移、异号匹配粒子给相同位移。每次模拟保持原求解器的概率分布，故配对平均具有单次模拟的期望与偏差。针对固定匹配，证明符号切换配对在最后扩散步使每对匹配粒子的方差贡献最小，并给出相对反射配对所消除方差的精确公式；对热方程，两项结果推广到每一步。

Result: 数值上测量了累积方差降低；在Burgers测试中，样本量由试点运行选定并在新运行上校验，符号切换配对用4次模拟即达到某均方误差目标，而独立采样需65次、反射配对需34次；相对同号配对（仅匹配同号粒子），在8192粒子下方差约低26%；在2048粒子下以约少40%的时间达到第二个目标；该增益在更多剖面、更晚时刻、其他粘性及三次通量下持续存在。

Conclusion: 符号切换配对是一种低成本改进重复场估计的方法，在异号粒子相遇处尤为有效。

Abstract: Gradient random-walk methods represent the spatial derivative of a solution by signed particles and recover the solution by summing their masses. We reduce the sampling error of such simulations for one-dimensional convection-diffusion equations by running them in pairs with particles matched in order of position. Reflected pairing, the standard antithetic choice, gives matched particles opposite displacements. In sign-switched pairing, matched particles of equal sign receive opposite displacements and those of opposite sign the same displacement. Each simulation keeps the probability distribution of the solver, so the pair average has the expectation and bias of one simulation. For a fixed matching, we prove that sign-switched pairing minimizes the variance contribution of each matched pair at the last diffusion step. We also derive an exact formula for the variance it removes relative to reflected pairing. For the heat equation both results extend to every step, and we measure the accumulated variance reduction numerically. In Burgers tests, with sample sizes chosen from pilot runs and checked on fresh runs, sign-switched pairing meets a mean-squared-error target with 4 simulations, compared with 65 for independent sampling and 34 for reflected pairing. Against within-sign pairing, which matches only particles of equal sign, it has about 26% lower variance with 8192 particles. With 2048 particles it meets a second target in about 40% less time. The gain persists for further profiles, later times, other viscosities, and a cubic flux, supporting sign-switched pairing as an inexpensive way to improve repeated field estimates where particles of opposite sign meet.

</details>


### [356] [Dirichlet--Neumann waveform relaxation for heterogeneous heat equations: fully discrete $l^2$ analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01475)
*Philipp Birken,Niklas Kotarsky*

Main category: math.NA

TL;DR: 本文针对不同空间域上通过低维界面耦合的两类线性热方程（共轭传热模型），采用Dirichlet–Neumann波形松弛进行分区求解，并利用指数加权Fourier技术在全离散情形下推导出有限时间T的l²误差估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者希望发展更高效的分区式（partitioned）耦合方法，而可靠误差估计是实现这一目标的前提，因此需要为全离散Dirichlet–Neumann波形松弛建立精确的误差刻画。

Method: 将两个定义在不同空间域的线性热方程通过低维界面耦合，构成共轭传热问题；使用Dirichlet–Neumann波形松弛使子问题可用各自独立代码求解（分区方法）；借助指数加权Fourier技术，在全离散设置下推导l²范数的有限时间误差估计。

Result: 所得全离散估计同时刻画线性与超线性收敛行为；当子求解器CFL数较大时，该估计接近已有的时间离散估计且与Δx₁、Δx₂无关；当CFL数较小时，收敛行为依赖于网格比Δx₁/Δx₂。数值实验表明该估计在广泛的网格尺寸Δx₁、Δx₂、时间步长Δt及有限时间T范围内均准确。

Conclusion: 全离散误差估计能够可靠预测Dirichlet–Neumann波形松弛在共轭传热耦合问题中的收敛特性，其准确性对大范围离散参数成立，为发展更高效的分区耦合方法提供了理论依据。

Abstract: We consider two coupled linear heat equations on different spatial domains that interact through a lower dimensional interface. This models conjugate heat transfer. The problem is solved using Dirichlet--Neumann waveform relaxation. This allows the subproblems to be solved using separate codes, a so called partitioned approach. Our overall goal is to develop more efficient partitioned methods, and to this end, we want reliable error estimates.
  Here, we use an exponentially weighted Fourier technique to derive new error estimates in $l^2$ for finite time $T$ in the fully discrete setting. These describe both linear and superlinear behavior. We show that the fully discrete estimate is close to a previously obtained time discrete estimate and independent of $Δx_1$ and $Δx_2$ when the CFL number in the subsolvers is large. We also show that the convergence behaviour depends on the ratio $Δx_1/Δx_2$ when the CFL number is small.
  Our numerical experiments show that the fully discrete estimate is accurate across a wide range of grid sizes $Δx_1, Δx_2$, time step sizes $Δt$ and $T$.

</details>


### [357] [Finite element exterior calculus for spectra and pseudospectra of advection-diffusion of differential forms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01501)
*Daniele Boffi,Kaibo Hu,Yizhou Liang,Umberto Zerbinati*

Main category: math.NA

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于有限元外微积分（FEEC）的方法研究发电机问题，重点考察用于计算微分形式对流-扩散算子谱与伪谱的结构保持有限元格式，其格式与分析建立在有限元de Rham复形之上。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 发电机作用的数值研究在流体力学中持续活跃但存在诸多挑战与未解问题；同时结构保持方法与有限元外微积分的发展，为重新审视数值发电机研究、探索计算中的开放问题提供了契机。

Method: 采用FEEC框架处理发电机问题，构造并分析结构保持的有限元格式，用以计算微分形式对流-扩散算子的谱与伪谱，格式与分析基于有限元de Rham复形。

Result: 提出了针对发电机问题的FEEC方法，并给出了基于有限元de Rham复形的结构保持有限元格式及其谱与伪谱计算方案及相应分析。

Conclusion: 结构保持有限元与FEEC为发电机问题的谱与伪谱计算提供了可行途径，有助于推动数值发电机研究中开放计算问题的探索。

Abstract: Numerical investigations of dynamo action have remained active in fluid mechanics over the past decades, presenting numerous challenges and open problems. Meanwhile, the development of structure-preserving methods and finite element exterior calculus (FEEC) inspires a revisit of numerical dynamo studies and an exploration of existing open questions in computation. In this paper, we present a FEEC approach for dynamo problems. In particular, we investigate structure-preserving finite element schemes for computing the spectra and pseudospectra of advection-diffusion operators of differential forms. The schemes and their analysis are based on finite element de Rham complexes.

</details>


### [358] [An Unfitted Hybrid High-Order Method for the Elastodynamics Problem with Imperfect Interface](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01504)
*Peiqi Huang,Erik Burman*

Main category: math.NA

TL;DR: 本文提出并分析了一种用于含线性滑移型不完美界面弹性波方程的无拟合混合高阶（HHO）方法，切单元自由度加倍、界面无自由度，通过局部应变重构与界面稳定化处理界面条件，证明了能量误差 $h^{k+1}$ 与 $L^2$ 误差 $h^{k+2}$ 且常数不依赖柔度参数与界面切割方式，数值实验验证了收敛率与鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对由两部件组成、其间为线性滑移型不完美界面（牵引连续而位移跳跃通过柔度张量正比于牵引）的介质中弹性波传播问题，传统拟合网格方法在处理界面切割网格、小切单元及柔度参数变化时存在困难，需要一种不依赖界面拟合且对柔度参数鲁棒的数值方法。

Method: 设计无拟合 HHO 方法：网格不拟合界面，在切单元中离散未知量加倍，用单元凝聚处理小切，界面不附未知量。核心两点为：每个切子单元内局部对称应变重构，按 Hansbo-Hansbo 思路通过正则化界面刚度 $\mathbf{S}_h=(h_T\delta^{-1}\mathbf{I}+\mathbf{K})^{-1}$ 引入界面条件；并构造由同一矩阵导出的界面稳定化。时间离散采用保持离散能量守恒的 Newmark 格式或最高四阶的单对角隐式 Runge-Kutta 格式。

Result: 对空间半离散问题证明了离散双线性形式的矫顽性与连续性，推导出能量误差估计为 $h^{k+1}$ 阶、$L^2$ 误差估计为 $h^{k+2}$ 阶，且常数不依赖于柔度参数以及界面切割网格的方式。二维数值实验验证了 $k\in\{1,2,3\}$ 的预测收敛率、对跨越十六个数量级柔度变化的鲁棒性，并展示了弹性波跨越未分辨滑移界面的传播。

Conclusion: 该无拟合 HHO 方法为含不完美界面的弹性波问题提供了界面不拟合、界面无自由度且对柔度参数与网格切割鲁棒的高阶离散格式，配合 Newmark 或高阶 SDIRK 时间格式，理论误差阶与数值结果一致。

Abstract: We design and analyse an unfitted hybrid high-order (HHO) method for the elastic wave equation in a medium made of two components separated by an imperfect interface of linear slip type, across which the traction is continuous and the displacement jump is proportional to the traction through a compliancy tensor $\bK=α\bI+(β-α)\bn\otimes\bn$. The mesh is not fitted to the interface: the discrete unknowns are doubled in the cut cells, the small cuts are cured by a cell agglomeration procedure, and no unknown is attached to the interface. The two specific ingredients of the method are a local symmetric strain reconstruction in each cut subcell, which incorporates the interface condition through the regularised interface stiffness $\bS_h=(h_Tδ^{-1}\bI+\bK)^{-1}$ in the spirit of Hansbo and Hansbo {\em{A finite element method for the simulation of strong and weak discontinuities in solid mechanics.}} {Comput. Methods Appl. Mech. Engrg.}, 193, 2004, and an interface stabilisation built from the same matrix. For the space semi-discrete problem we prove that the discrete bilinear form is coercive and continuous, and we derive an energy-error estimate of order $h^{k+1}$ and an $L^2$-error estimate of order $h^{k+2}$, with constants independent of the compliancy parameters and of how the interface cuts the mesh. The scheme is combined either with the Newmark scheme, which conserves a discrete energy exactly, or with singly diagonally implicit Runge--Kutta schemes of order up to four. Numerical experiments in two dimensions confirm the predicted convergence rates for $k\in\{1,2,3\}$, the robustness with respect to the compliancy over sixteen orders of magnitude, and illustrate the propagation of elastic waves across an unresolved slipping interface.

</details>


### [359] [Deterministic and stochastic particle methods for the Fokker-Planck equation in S--formulation with application to point set registration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01700)
*Klaas Willems,Angelo Iollo,Giovanni Russo,Tommaso Taddei*

Main category: math.NA

TL;DR: 本文提出两种基于Fokker-Planck方程的有界域点集配准粒子方法：一是基于移动最小二乘离散S-公式的确定性粒子法，二是求解Langevin随机微分方程的蒙特卡洛法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 点集配准在有界域内的求解存在粒子云强压缩/膨胀与障碍物边界处理的困难，需要兼顾精度、可扩展性与高维适用性的数值方法。

Method: 第一种方法对S-公式采用移动最小二乘离散，粒子（移动网格点）随漂移场平流并趋向目标分布，扩散在动态演化粒子云上求解，通过新型幽灵点方法施加反射边界条件处理障碍物；第二种方法为关联Langevin随机微分方程的蒙特卡洛求解器，利用演化粒子密度的对数梯度局部近似，从单条随机轨迹中提取宏观渗透路径。

Result: 通过大量数值实验展示了两种方法的主要特性与性能；蒙特卡洛方法因内在并行性而具有优异可扩展性，适合高维配准问题。

Conclusion: 两类粒子方法为有界域点集配准提供了可行途径，分别在边界/障碍物处理与高维可扩展性方面具有优势。

Abstract: We present two particle methods for point set registration in bounded domains based on the Fokker-Planck equation. The first method relies on a moving least squares discretization of the S--formulation, in which moving grid points (particles) are advected by the drift with the target distribution, diffusion is resolved on a dynamically evolving particle cloud. This setting naturally leads to strong compression and expansion of the particle cloud. Obstacles are handled by enforcing reflective boundary conditions through a novel ghost point method. The second method is a Monte Carlo solver for the associated Langevin stochastic differential equation. It relies on a local approximation of the logarithmic gradient of the evolving particle density to extract macroscopic osmotic paths from individual stochastic trajectories. Owing to its inherent parallelism, this method exhibits excellent scalability and is well suited for high-dimensional registration problems. We illustrate the main features and performance of both approaches through extensive numerical experiments.

</details>


### [360] [Toeplitz Infinite GMRES for Parameterized Linear Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01740)
*Weiguo Gao,Feiyang Jiang*

Main category: math.NA

TL;DR: 本文提出 Toeplitz infinite GMRES，用于在大量参数点上求解大型稀疏解析参数化系统 A(s)x(s)=z。方法利用伴随 Krylov 序列中的块上三角 Toeplitz 结构构造 Arnoldi 过程并恢复解近似，避免存储完整 Arnoldi 向量；推导出每 p 步 Arnoldi 仅需 O(np²+p³) 算术量和 O(np+p²) 存储的增量递推，并提出动态生成元刷新策略抑制递推中的消去误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 求解大型稀疏解析参数化系统 A(s)x(s)=z 时需在众多参数值处反复求解，传统 GMRES 需为每个参数值重新构造并存储完整 Arnoldi 向量，计算与存储代价高。作者希望利用参数化系统伴随 Krylov 序列中固有的块上三角 Toeplitz 结构，实现跨参数值的高效共享计算，从而降低重复求解的开销。

Method: 核心是挖掘 companion Krylov 序列的块上三角 Toeplitz 结构，并据此构造 Arnoldi 过程与解近似恢复，无需存储完整 Arnoldi 向量。推导增量递推，给出 p 步 Arnoldi 的 O(np²+p³) 算术量与 O(np+p²) 存储（不含分解准备工作，且假设系数作用与三角求解为线性代价）。引入动态生成元刷新（generator-refreshing）策略以缓解基本递推中的数值消去。针对具有固定分离表示的矩阵函数，进一步提出基于紧凑、收缩幂零矩阵的隐式重基（rebased）方法；两种变体在精确算术下均保持 Arnoldi 过程，其中重基方法要求矩阵函数作用精确。此外，给出了平方可和 Taylor 系数的残差下界，用以解释归一化单位圆外的缩放障碍。

Result: 理论分析表明所提方法在精确算术下保持 Arnoldi 过程，并给出 p 步计算复杂度 O(np²+p³) 与存储复杂度 O(np+p²)。残差下界结果从理论上解释了归一化单位圆外出现的缩放障碍。数值实验验证了所提 Toeplitz infinite GMRES 及其重基变体在计算效率上的优势。

Conclusion: Toeplitz infinite GMRES 通过利用块上三角 Toeplitz 结构，实现了参数化稀疏系统在大批参数值上的高效求解，显著降低了传统方法在存储和算术上的开销。动态生成元刷新与隐式重基两种变体分别提升数值稳定性与矩阵函数作用场景的适用性，理论与实验共同支撑了方法的有效性。

Abstract: We develop Toeplitz infinite GMRES for solving large sparse analytic parameterized systems $A(s)x(s)=z$ at many parameter values. The method exploits a block upper triangular Toeplitz structure in the companion Krylov sequence to construct the Arnoldi process and recover solution approximations without storing full Arnoldi vectors. We derive incremental recurrences requiring $\mathcal{O}(np^2+p^3)$ arithmetic and $\mathcal{O}(np+p^2)$ storage for $p$ Arnoldi steps, excluding factorization setup and assuming linear-cost coefficient actions and triangular solves. A dynamic generator-refreshing strategy addresses cancellation in the basic recurrence. For matrix functions admitting a fixed separated representation, we further develop an implicitly rebased method based on a compact, contractive nilpotent matrix. Both variants preserve the Arnoldi process in exact arithmetic, with exact matrix-function actions required for the rebased method. A residual lower bound for square-summable Taylor coefficients explains a scaling obstruction outside the normalized unit disk. Theoretical analysis and numerical experiments illustrate the computational efficiency of the proposed methods.

</details>


### [361] [Adaptive Multiresolution Diffusion Operators: A Variational Theory on Evolving Multiresolution Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01809)
*Christian Tantardini,Stig Rune Jensen,Roberto Di Remigio Eikås,Joakim Henrik Beck*

Main category: math.NA

TL;DR: 本文提出一种自适应多分辨率下的状态依赖扩散变分框架，扩散算子由自适应状态本身生成；在时间离散变分原理下建立存在性、离散能量不等式与收缩性，并应用于正则反问题（AMDI），在去噪中仅用不到10%的活跃表示即保持高质量结构重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典自适应小波方法在演化逼近空间上表示预先给定的算子，而细化与粗化仅改变表示空间、不改变算子本身。本文希望让扩散算子由自适应状态（多分辨率树、活跃逼近空间与基、系数表示）共同生成，从而在细化/粗化时同时改变表示、交互图与算子，以更好刻画状态依赖扩散与异构数据上的分辨率局部化。

Method: 状态由容许多分辨率树、其活跃逼近空间与基及对应系数表示组成，并确定对称非负交互形式与半正定内蕴扩散算子。由于自适应层级通过离散拓扑变化演化，耦合动力学以时间离散变分原理而非固定空间上的微分演化来表述。针对正则化反问题，构建AMDI，在状态依赖能量中组合数据保真、内蕴扩散、系数稀疏性与树复杂度。

Result: 建立了离散更新的存在性、离散能量不等式、系数空间零模态以及冻结自适应状态下的收缩性。数值实验验证了算子恒等式、考察了细化交换子的衰减，并确认了离散能量耗散。自适应Haar与高阶多小波计算展示了异构数据上的分辨率局部化。在去噪中，AMDI以不到10%的完整活跃表示保持高结构重建质量，且在留出噪声实现上表现稳定。

Conclusion: 该框架将自适应多分辨率表示与状态依赖扩散算子统一于离散变分原理之下，为自适应扩散成像提供了理论与数值基础，并在去噪任务中展现出高表示效率与稳定性。

Abstract: We develop a variational framework for state-dependent diffusion on adaptive multiresolution representations in which the diffusion operator is generated by the adaptive state itself. The state consists of an admissible multiresolution tree, its active approximation space and basis, and the corresponding coefficient representation. It determines a symmetric nonnegative interaction form and an associated positive semidefinite intrinsic diffusion operator. In contrast to classical adaptive wavelet methods, where a prescribed operator is represented on an evolving approximation space, refinement and coarsening here modify simultaneously the representation, interaction graph, and operator. Because the adaptive hierarchy evolves through discrete topological changes, the coupled dynamics are formulated through a time-discrete variational principle rather than a differential evolution on a fixed space. We establish existence of the discrete updates, a discrete energy inequality, the coefficient-space null mode, and contractivity for frozen adaptive states. For regularized inverse problems, the construction yields Adaptive Multiresolution Diffusion Imaging (AMDI), combining data fidelity, intrinsic diffusion, coefficient sparsity, and tree complexity in a state-dependent energy. Numerical experiments verify the assembled operator identities, examine refinement-commutator decay, and confirm discrete energy dissipation. Adaptive Haar and higher-order multiwavelet calculations demonstrate localization of resolution on heterogeneous data. In denoising, AMDI retains high structural reconstruction quality with less than 10\% of the full active representation, with stable behavior across held-out noise realizations.

</details>


### [362] [Approximation and computation of the geodesic Sinkhorn distance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02007)
*Hugo Lavenant,Jonas Luckhardt,Bernhard Schmitzer*

Main category: math.NA

TL;DR: 本文研究如何逼近与计算熵最优传输诱导的Sinkhorn散度黎曼度量 d_S，证明空间离散下的Gromov–Hausdorff收敛与测地线收敛，以及时间链式离散的Γ-收敛，并据此设计数值格式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前作在概率分布空间上由熵最优传输（Sinkhorn散度 S_ε）构造了黎曼度量 d_S，但缺乏可实际计算该度量的方法，因此需要研究其逼近与数值实现。

Method: 对底空间采用越来越细的欧拉离散化，证明度量本身的Gromov–Hausdorff收敛及测地线收敛；对时间方向采用链式离散 N∑_{k=0}^{N-1} S_ε(μ_k, μ_{k+1})，证明其到定义 d_S 的能量泛函的Γ-收敛。

Result: 建立了空间离散的Gromov–Hausdorff收敛与测地线收敛，以及时间离散能量泛函的Γ-收敛，并由此导出可用于计算 d_S 近似值的数值方案并予以实现。

Conclusion: 该工作为Sinkhorn散度诱导的黎曼度量提供了理论保证下的空间与时间离散逼近框架，并给出可实现的数值算法。

Abstract: In [H. Lavenant, J. Luckhardt, G. Mordant, B. Schmitzer, L. Tamanini, The Riemannian geometry of Sinkhorn divergences. Ann. Inst. H. Poincaré Anal. Non Linéaire 43 (2026)] we introduced a Riemannian metric $\mathsf{d}_S$ on the space of probability distributions obtained from entropic optimal transport, specifically from the Sinkhorn divergence $S_\varepsilon$. In the present work we discuss how to approximate and compute $\mathsf{d}_S$. Spatially, we prove Gromov--Hausdorff convergence of the metric and convergence of geodesics for increasingly fine Eulerian discretization of the base space. Temporally, we show $Γ$-convergence of the chain discretization $N \sum_{k=0}^{N-1} S_\varepsilon(μ_k, μ_{k+1})$ to the energy functional defining $\mathsf{d}_S$. We deduce and implement numerical schemes to compute approximations of $\mathsf{d}_S$.

</details>


### [363] [Entropy dissipative high order schemes for a hyperbolic model of two-layer thin film flow](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02059)
*Rahul Barthwal,Philipp Öffner,Chetan Singh,Jan Zawallich*

Main category: math.NA

TL;DR: 本文为描述两层不混溶薄膜流动（含完全可溶溶质粒子）的一阶双曲守恒律系统，构造了高阶熵耗散格式，并比较了精确与近似两种熵守恒通量构造方式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 两层薄膜流动系统的熵守恒通量构造中，精确形式推导复杂，而常用简化近似虽应用广泛但结构较差，需明确二者在实现成本与求解效率上的差异。

Method: 基于Tadmor熵守恒通量思想，分别采用精确构造与常用简化近似两种通量评估过程，并将其嵌入熵耗散有限差分框架与熵耗散间断Galerkin谱元法中。

Result: 通过两种不同空间离散化的数值实验，验证了所提方法的性能与鲁棒性，发现数值通量的选择对求解器效率有显著影响。

Conclusion: 精确熵守恒通量构造虽推导复杂，但结构更规整、实现成本更低；简化近似构造更简单却导致更高的计算成本，通量选择对求解效率影响明显。

Abstract: In this article, we develop high-order, entropy-dissipative schemes for a hyperbolic system of conservation laws describing the first-order dynamics of two-layer thin-film flows of immiscible fluids with perfectly soluble solute particles. The key aspect is to construct entropy-conservative fluxes in the sense of Tadmor. Here, we consider and compare two different construction processes: an exact formulation and a commonly used simplified approximation in the flux evaluation. While the approximate approach is simpler at the level of construction and is frequently employed in practice (also in other contexts), it is less structured, leading to increased computational cost in the implementation compared to the exact formulation, which has been much more complicated to derive. We employ these fluxes within both an entropy-dissipative finite-difference framework and an entropy-dissipative discontinuous Galerkin spectral element method. Through numerical experiments using two distinct spatial discretizations, we investigate the performance and robustness of the proposed methods and demonstrate that the choice of numerical flux has a noticeable impact on the efficiency of the resulting solvers.

</details>


### [364] [Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Free-Boundary Partial Differential Equations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02084)
*Tan Phuong Dong Le*

Main category: math.NA

TL;DR: 该论文在物理信息框架下利用Kolmogorov-Arnold网络(KAN)近似求解自由边界问题，通过残差型损失函数融入障碍约束、PDE不等式、互补条件与边界条件，并在线性椭圆障碍问题、非线性p-Laplacian障碍问题及时间相关单相Stefan问题上与PINN和残差网络基线对比。实验表明KAN能取得较低的相对L2与L∞误差，并能准确刻画接触区与移动界面，是求解自由边界PDE的有效替代方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自由边界问题（如障碍问题、Stefan问题）涉及未知的接触区与移动界面，传统数值方法（如有限元、水平集）在网格生成、界面追踪与高维扩展方面存在困难。物理信息神经网络（PINN）虽无需网格，但在处理自由边界带来的不等式约束、互补条件与强非线性时，精度与稳定性仍有局限。作者希望探索KAN这一新型网络表示在自由边界PDE求解中的潜力，并与PINN等方法进行系统比较。

Method: 提出基于KAN的物理信息求解器：将障碍约束、PDE不等式、互补条件以及边界条件统一编码为残差型损失函数，在物理信息框架下进行训练。研究对象包括线性椭圆障碍问题、非线性p-Laplacian障碍问题及时间相关单相Stefan问题。将KAN求解器与PINN和残差网络（Residual Network）基线在相同问题上进行对比，评估相对L2和L∞误差、接触区与移动界面的分辨能力。

Result: 数值实验表明，KAN能够在三类自由边界问题上取得较低相对L2与L∞误差，并能准确分辨接触区域与移动界面，整体性能优于或可与PINN及残差网络基线相比。结果说明KAN表示在求解自由边界PDE方面具有竞争力。

Conclusion: KAN为自由边界PDE的物理信息求解提供了一种有效替代方案，能够在无需网格的情况下处理障碍约束、互补条件与移动界面。未来可进一步扩展至更高维、更复杂边界条件及其他类型的自由边界问题。

Abstract: We study free-boundary problems within a physics-informed framework using Kolmogorov-Arnold network (KAN) approximations. The proposed approach incorporates obstacle constraints, partial differential equation (PDE) inequalities, complementarity conditions, and boundary conditions through residual-based loss functions. We consider a linear elliptic obstacle problem, a nonlinear $p$-Laplacian obstacle problem, and a time-dependent one-phase Stefan problem. The proposed KAN solver is compared with physics-informed neural network (PINN) and residual-network baselines. Numerical experiments show that KANs achieve low relative $L^2$ and $L^\infty$ errors while accurately resolving contact regions and moving interfaces. The results indicate that KAN representations provide an effective alternative for solving free-boundary PDEs.

</details>

### [365] [Global Strong Solutions for the Ternary Maxwell-Stefan Diffusion System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00162)
*Dieter Bothe*

Main category: math.AP

TL;DR: 本文证明归一化等温等压三元Maxwell-Stefan扩散系统在有界C^{2+α₀}区域上的全局强适定性，无需小性条件，并给出正时间Hölder正则性与严格正性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 三元Maxwell-Stefan扩散系统的全局强适定性与正性此前多依赖小性条件或特殊摩擦结构；本文旨在任意正常数二元摩擦与相容非负初值下，去掉小性条件建立全局理论。

Method: 利用迹-行列式变量将不同摩擦情形分解为两个满足带反对称二次耦合的标量抛物方程的谱根；用Euler-Poisson-Darboux单侧截断并以混合熵稳定化，得到边界De Giorgi振荡衰减与正时间Hölder正则性；混合熵Hessian给出局部对称化子，结合锥法向Schauder估计与冻结极大L_p正则性获得一致C^{1+a}控制与终端迹界。

Result: 在任意正常数二元摩擦和相容非负初值下证明了全局强适定性；获得正时间Hölder正则性、一致C^{1+a}控制与排除有限时刻爆破的统一终端迹界；重复摩擦情形退化为三角形标量抛物系统；正守恒质量的每个分量在正时间严格为正。

Conclusion: 该工作在不设小性条件下建立了三元Maxwell-Stefan扩散系统的全局强适定性与严格正性，方法依赖混合熵稳定化、De Giorgi振荡衰减、Schauder估计与极大L_p正则性的组合。

Abstract: We prove global strong well-posedness for the normalized isothermal, isobaric ternary Maxwell-Stefan diffusion system on bounded $C^{2+α_0}$ domains, for arbitrary positive constant binary frictions and compatible nonnegative initial data, without a smallness condition. For distinct frictions, trace--determinant variables produce two separated spectral roots satisfying scalar parabolic equations with antisymmetric quadratic coupling. Euler-Poisson-Darboux one-sided truncations, stabilized by the mixing entropy, yield boundary De Giorgi oscillation decay and positive-time Hölder regularity. The mixing-entropy Hessian then provides a local symmetrizer; conormal Schauder estimates give uniform $C^{1+a}$ control, and frozen maximal $L_p$-regularity yields a uniform terminal trace bound excluding finite-time breakdown. Repeated frictions reduce to triangular scalar parabolic systems. Every component with positive conserved mass is strictly positive for positive time.

</details>


### [366] [Global Strong Solutions for the Affine Darken Class of Maxwell-Stefan Diffusion Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00166)
*Dieter Bothe*

Main category: math.AP

TL;DR: 该文在Stieltjes坐标与De Giorgi正则性框架下，证明仿射Darken类多组分Maxwell-Stefan扩散的全局最大-$L^p$强适定性（无需小性假设），并给出一般光滑正Darken示踪扩散率的直接约束通量形式、混合熵对称化、Fisher耗散、局部适定性及指数收敛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Bothe-Druet的核-对角闭包将多组分Darken扩散刻画为热力学一致的Maxwell-Stefan模型，其本构数据为组分示踪扩散率，但该类模型的全局强适定性与正则性结构尚缺乏无小性条件的系统分析，尤其缺乏保持Stieltjes特征框架的显式刻画。

Method: 沿用近期预印本中为加性Maxwell-Stefan摩擦引入的Stieltjes坐标与De Giorgi正则性框架；针对具有组分依赖标量系数、一致正示踪扩散率的仿射Darken类，建立全局最大-$L^p$强适定性与特征框架保持性的等价刻画；对一般光滑一致正Darken示踪扩散率推导直接约束通量形式与混合熵对称化。

Result: 仿射Darken类在无小性假设下获得全局最大-$L^p$强适定性；该恰好是保持固定Stieltjes特征框架的最大Darken类；一般光滑一致正情形下得到直接约束通量形式、精确混合熵对称化、Fisher耗散、组分一致法向椭圆性及局部强适定性；仿射类解一致远离单纯形边界、正时刻后变经典解并指数收敛于平衡；常乘性摩擦（含重复因子）经等因子分组被覆盖。

Conclusion: 仿射Darken类是保持全局论证所需Stieltjes特征框架的最大子类，其解具正性与渐近稳定性；所得约束通量、熵对称化与Fisher耗散为一般Darken扩散的适定性分析提供了统一变分结构，并可推广至常乘性摩擦的重因子情形。

Abstract: The core-diagonal closure of Bothe and Druet identifies multicomponent Darken diffusion as a thermodynamically consistent Maxwell-Stefan model in which the constitutive data are species tracer diffusivities. Building on the Stieltjes-coordinate and De Giorgi regularity framework introduced in our recent preprint for additive Maxwell-Stefan frictions, we prove global maximal-$L^p$ strong well-posedness, without smallness assumptions, for the affine Darken class with composition-dependent scalar coefficients and uniformly positive tracer diffusivities. We show that this is exactly the maximal Darken class preserving the fixed Stieltjes eigenframe underlying the global argument. For general smooth, uniformly positive Darken tracer diffusivities we also derive the direct constrained flux form, exact mixing-entropy symmetrization, Fisher dissipation, composition-uniform normal ellipticity, and local strong well-posedness. Solutions in the affine class remain uniformly separated from the simplex boundary, become classical for positive times, and converge exponentially to equilibrium. Constant multiplicative frictions, including repeated factors, are covered by grouping species with equal factors.

</details>


### [367] [Banach-Valued Stieltjes Calculus and Linear Parabolic Evolution Equations with Posterior States](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00171)
*Francisco J. Fernández*

Main category: math.AP

TL;DR: 本文在Gelfand三元组上建立了Banach值侧向Stieltjes微积分，用于线性演化方程，采用后验状态形式化问题，证明了积公式、弱-强重构定理及Lions-Magenes能量等式的Stieltjes类比，并通过Galerkin逼近和Rothe格式独立构造解，最后以Stieltjes时间热方程为例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 处理Stieltjes测度驱动（含原子）的线性演化方程在Gelfand三元组框架下的适定性问题，特别是原子处隐式变分预解的出现，以及现有前向Stieltjes-Bochner演化的Aubin-Lions定理无法自动适用于后验能量空间的困难。

Method: 1) 建立Banach值侧向Stieltjes微积分；2) 采用后验状态形式化：D_g u + A(t)S_g u = f，原子处得到隐式变分预解 (I+δA(r))u(r+)=u(r)+δf(r)；3) 证明Banach值积公式、弱-强重构定理、Lions-Magenes能量等式的Stieltjes类比；4) 在可分Hilbert情形下通过谱带构造自动给出稳定投影链，并包含精确正跳跃贡献(1/2)Σ‖u(r+)-u(r)‖²_H；5) 分别用Galerkin逼近和适配Stieltjes质量及原子的Rothe格式独立构造解。

Result: 证明了Banach值侧向积公式、弱-强重构定理及Lions-Magenes能量等式的Stieltjes类比；谱带构造确保了稳定投影链的自动存在，其能量等式包含精确正跳跃项；Galerkin逼近和Rothe格式均给出存在性，且Rothe构造不使用空间投影；说明了现有Aubin-Lions定理不适用于后验能量空间且在线性强制情形下不需要；以Stieltjes时间热方程作为模型应用。

Conclusion: 该工作为Stieltjes时间驱动的线性演化方程提供了完整框架，明确了后验状态形式化在原子处的关键作用，给出了不依赖Aubin-Lions定理的两种独立存在性构造，并将结论定位于既有Stieltjes抛物方程、一般测度驱动演化及算子值测度抛物系统的工作之间，同时声明未对测度驱动抛物理论和Galerkin逼近本身主张优先权。

Abstract: We develop a Banach-valued lateral Stieltjes calculus adapted to linear evolution equations on a Gelfand triple \[
  V\hookrightarrow H\simeq H^*\hookrightarrow V^*. \] The evolution problem is formulated with the posterior state, \[
  D_g u(t)+A(t) S_g u(t)=f(t),\qquad u(a)=u_0. \] This choice is decisive at atoms of the Stieltjes measure: if $δ=Δ_g(r)>0$, the equation yields the implicit variational resolvent \[
  (I+δA(r))u(r^+)=u(r)+δf(r). \] We prove a Banach-valued lateral product formula, a weak--strong reconstruction theorem, and a Stieltjes analogue of the Lions--Magenes energy identity. In the separable Hilbert setting considered here, the stable projection chain used in the proof is shown to exist automatically by a spectral-band construction. The latter contains the exact positive jump contribution \[
  \frac12\sum_r\|u(r^+)-u(r)\|_H^2. \] Existence is constructed independently by Galerkin approximation and by a Rothe scheme adapted to the Stieltjes mass and its atoms. The Rothe construction does not use spatial projections. We also explain why the available Aubin--Lions theorem for anterior Stieltjes--Bochner evolution graphs is not automatically applicable to the posterior energy space and, in the present linear coercive setting, is not needed. A heat equation with Stieltjes time is included as a model application. The claims are positioned relative to earlier Stieltjes parabolic equations, general measure-driven evolution, and operator-valued-measure parabolic systems; no priority is claimed for measure-driven parabolic theory or Galerkin approximation in general.

</details>


### [368] [Logarithmic concentration for the focusing cubic Schrödinger equation on the two-dimensional torus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00241)
*Xi Chen*

Main category: math.AP

TL;DR: 在二维环面方域上，构造了聚焦三次非线性薛定谔方程的一个双向时间全局光滑解，其在正无穷时刻于一点集中，质量等于欧氏基态质量且能量为零，并证明该解在单剖面渐近类中的唯一性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 研究环面上聚焦NLS的集中现象，特别是质量等于欧氏基态质量、能量为零所对应的临界情形下解的长时间动力学行为。

Method: 利用剖面与其周期像之间的指数小相互作用机制进行构造；由精确的质量与能量约束选取集中分支，并用移动约束空间上的正能量控制任意固定正则阶下的终值问题；通过定量单剖面渐近类证明唯一性。

Result: 得到双向全局光滑解，集中于一点；其集中尺度满足 L/λ(t)=2log t+(11/2)log log t+O(1)；解逼近带相位的周期化基态，误差在每个固定Sobolev空间中趋于零，H^s 范数渐近于显式常数乘以 (log t)^s；唯一性在常数相位与时间平移意义下成立。

Conclusion: 该工作揭示环面上聚焦NLS解的对数式集中机制，主要由周期像的指数小相互作用驱动，质量与能量约束决定分支选择，为临界质量能量下的长时间渐近行为及唯一性提供精确刻画。

Abstract: We construct a smooth solution of the focusing cubic nonlinear Schrödinger equation on a square two-dimensional torus which is global in both time directions and concentrates at one point as time tends to positive infinity. Its mass is the mass of the Euclidean ground state and its energy is zero. If $λ(t)$ denotes its concentration scale and $L$ the period, then $L/λ(t)=2\log t+\frac{11}{2}\log\log t+O(1)$. The solution approaches a phased, periodized ground state with an error tending to zero in every fixed Sobolev space. In particular, its $H^s$ norm is asymptotic to an explicit constant times $(\log t)^s$ for every $s>0$. We also prove uniqueness, up to constant phase and time translation, within the quantitative single-profile asymptotic class used in the construction. The mechanism is the exponentially small interaction of the profile with its periodic images. Exact mass and energy constraints select the concentrating branch, while a positive energy on the moving constrained space controls the terminal-value problem at every fixed regularity order.

</details>


### [369] [Endpoint Mapping Properties of Wave Operators for Schrödinger Operators in Dimensions $n\ge3$](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00869)
*Han Cheng,Changxing Miao,Xiaohua Yao*

Main category: math.AP

TL;DR: 研究 $\mathbb R^n$ 上 Schrödinger 算子低能波算子的端点映射性质：四维中零能共振破坏 $L^1$ 有界性；零能本征值（无共振）时给出各维 $L^p$ 完整分类，$L^\infty$ 有界性等价于 $V\psi$ 的第零、一、二阶调和矩为零。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低能波算子在端点空间（如 $L^1$、$L^\infty$）的映射性质对色散估计与散射理论至关重要；既往结果对零能共振与本征值情形下的端点有界性缺乏系统刻画，尤其四维共振是否破坏 $L^1$ 有界性、以及零能本征值下 $L^p$ 分类尚不完整。

Method: 在衰减条件 $|V(x)|\lesssim\langle x\rangle^{-\beta}$ 下分析零能波算子；四维情形取 $\beta>10$ 证明零能共振（不论是否兼为本征值）破坏 $L^1$ 有界性；无共振的零能本征值情形取 $\beta>n+4$，通过识别有限秩障碍并证明剩余本征值修正项无法抵消其临界渐近轮廓，完成 $L^p$ 分类。

Result: 四维中零能共振阻止 $L^1$ 有界性，无论零是否同时为本征值；对无共振的零能本征值，在 $n\ge3$ 且 $\beta>n+4$ 下得到完整低能 $L^p$ 分类，且 $L^\infty$ 有界性等价于对每个零能本征函数 $\psi$，$V\psi$ 的第零、第一及调和第二阶矩为零。

Conclusion: 零能处共振与本征值对波算子的端点有界性有本质不同的影响：共振恒破坏 $L^1$ 有界性，而无共振本征值的端点性质由 $V\psi$ 的低阶调和矩精确控制；相应结论在高能界可得时同样适用于完整波算子。

Abstract: We study endpoint mapping properties of low-energy wave operators for Schrödinger operators $H=-Δ+V$ on $\mathbb R^n$, $n\ge3$. In dimension four, we prove that a zero-energy resonance prevents $L^1$ boundedness, whether or not zero is also an eigenvalue, under $|V(x)|\lesssim\langle x\rangle^{-β}$ with $β>10$. For a zero-energy eigenvalue without a resonance, we obtain a complete low-energy $L^p$ classification in every dimension $n\ge3$ under $β>n+4$. In particular, $L^\infty$ boundedness is equivalent to the vanishing of the zeroth, first, and harmonic second moments of $Vψ$ for every zero-energy eigenfunction $ψ$. The proof identifies the finite-rank obstruction and shows that the remaining eigenvalue correction cannot cancel its critical asymptotic profiles. The same conclusions hold for the full wave operators when the corresponding high-energy bounds are available.

</details>


### [370] [Global Well-Posedness of the Kuramoto--Sivashinsky Equation in One and Two Dimensions under a Codimension-One Constraint](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00248)
*Harsh Tiwari,Manil T. Mohan*

Main category: math.AP

TL;DR: 研究带余维一约束的KS方程在1、2、3维的适定性：1维全局适定，2维在无小性假设下获全局强解，3维存在维数相关的本质障碍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: KS方程在无约束情形下高维全局强解适定性仍是公开问题；本文通过引入保持L²范数的余维一约束获得一致先验界，以探索该约束能否克服无约束情形下的困难及其空间维数限制。

Method: 对KS方程施加余维一约束以保持L²范数并提供一致先验界并用于高阶能量估计。1维采用Fourier--Galerkin近似与紧性论证；2、3维先用解析半群理论与Banach不动点定理证局部强解存在唯一；2维结合保L²范数、Agmon不等式与高阶能量估计控制非线性项。

Result: 1维：建立全局适定性。2、3维：建立局部强解的存在唯一性。2维：对任意充分正则初始数据、无任何小性假设，获得全局强解的存在唯一性，即约束二维KS方程的全局适定性（与无约束情形对照，后者全局强解适定性一般仍公开）。3维：约束仅给出一致L²界，插值与Agmon估计不足以闭合高阶能量估计。

Conclusion: 余维一约束使2维KS方程在无小性假设下获得全局适定性，优于对应的无约束问题；而3维的失败揭示了将全局正则性论证推广至3维存在真正依赖于空间维数的障碍。

Abstract: We study the Kuramoto--Sivashinsky (KS) equation in one, two, and three spatial dimensions subject to a codimension-one constraint. The constraint preserves the \(L^2\)-norm of the solution and consequently provides a uniform a priori bound that plays a central role in the higher-order energy estimates. In one spatial dimension, we establish global well-posedness by means of a Fourier--Galerkin approximation and compactness arguments. In two and three dimensions, we first prove the existence and uniqueness of local strong solutions using analytic semigroup theory and the Banach fixed-point theorem. In two dimensions, the preserved \(L^2\)-norm, combined with the Agmon inequality and suitable higher-order energy estimates, allows us to control the nonlinear terms and obtain global-in-time a priori bounds. Consequently, we establish the existence and uniqueness of global strong solutions for arbitrary sufficiently regular initial data, without any smallness assumption. This provides a global well-posedness result for the constrained two-dimensional KS equation, in contrast with the corresponding unconstrained problem, for which global well-posedness of strong solutions remains open in general. In three dimensions, although the constraint yields a uniform \(L^2\)-bound, the available interpolation and Agmon estimates are insufficient to close the higher-order energy estimate. This identifies a genuine dimension-dependent obstruction to extending the global regularity argument to three dimensions.

</details>


### [371] [Optimal Control of 2D Navier--Stokes Equations with Constraints of Finite Codimension](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00249)
*Manil T. Mohan*

Main category: math.AP

TL;DR: 研究投影到H-单位球面流形切空间上的二维Navier-Stokes方程最优控制问题，建立强解全局存在唯一性、最优对存在性、一阶必要最优性条件及控制到状态映射的Fréchet可微性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为约束于非线性流形上的流体流动最优控制提供严格的分析基础，处理状态被约束在H-单位球面流形上的Navier-Stokes方程控制问题。

Method: 将二维Navier-Stokes方程投影到H-单位球面流形M的切空间，得到有限余维的约束演化系统；采用Faedo-Galerkin逼近证明强解全局存在唯一性与一致能量估计；构造切丛TM上的最优控制系统推导一阶必要最优性条件；分析控制到状态映射的可微性并刻画线性化系统。

Result: 证明了带外控制U∈L²(0,T;H)的约束Navier-Stokes方程强解全局存在唯一性及一致能量估计；二次代价泛函的最优控制问题至少存在一个最优对(u*,U*)；控制满足U*(t)∈T_{u*(t)}M；控制到状态映射在C([0,T];H)∩L²(0,T;V)中Fréchet可微，线性化状态为保持切条件的线性化约束系统的唯一弱解。

Conclusion: 该结果为约束在非线性流形上的流体流动最优控制提供了严格的分析基础。

Abstract: We study an optimal control problem for the two-dimensional Navier-Stokes equations projected onto the tangent space of the $\mathbb{H}$-unit sphere manifold $\mathcal{M} := \{\boldsymbol{u} \in \mathbb{H} : \|\boldsymbol{u}\|_{\mathbb{H}}=1\}$. This geometric projection yields a constrained evolution system of finite codimension, ensuring that the state remains on $\mathcal{M}$ for all times. Using a Faedo-Galerkin approximation technique, we establish the global existence and uniqueness of strong solutions to the constrained Navier-Stokes equations with external controls $\boldsymbol{U} \in \mathrm{L}^2(0,T;\mathbb{H})$, together with uniform energy estimates. The associated optimal control problem, minimizing a quadratic cost functional subject to the manifold constraint, is shown to admit at least one optimal pair $(\boldsymbol{u}^*,\boldsymbol{U}^*)$. We derive the first-order necessary optimality conditions by formulating an optimal control system whose state-control pair $(\boldsymbol{u}^*,\boldsymbol{U}^*)$ evolves on the tangent bundle $T\mathcal{M}$ of the constraint manifold $\mathcal{M}$. In this setting, the control satisfies $\boldsymbol{U}^*(t)\in T_{\boldsymbol{u}^*(t)}\mathcal{M}$ for all $t\in[0,T]$, ensuring that the dynamics remain confined to the tangent bundle $T\mathcal{M}$. Furthermore, we establish the Fréchet differentiability of the control-to-state mapping $\boldsymbol{U}\mapsto \boldsymbol{u}_{\boldsymbol{U}}$ in $\mathrm{C}([0,T];\mathbb{H})\cap\mathrm{L}^2(0,T;\mathbb{V})$, with the corresponding linearized state characterized as the unique weak solution of a linearized constrained Navier-Stokes system preserving the tangency condition. These results provide a rigorous analytical foundation for the optimal control of fluid flows constrained to nonlinear manifolds.

</details>


### [372] [Global Well-Posedness for Planar Compressible Magnetohydrodynamics with Degenerate Viscosity on Unbounded Domains](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00278)
*Shixuan Li,Hongyu Wang*

Main category: math.AP

TL;DR: 本文研究一维平面可压缩磁流体动力学(MHD)系统在无界区域上的初边值问题。在纵向粘性系数按比容幂律退化、热传导系数按温度幂律变化的情形下，证明了当粘性指数足够小时，对任意大初值存在唯一整体强解，并给出比容与温度的上下界及解的长时间渐近行为。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 可压缩MHD系统在无界区域上解的整体适定性是数学物理中具有挑战性的问题，尤其当粘性系数随密度趋于真空而退化时，方程失去一致抛物性，经典方法难以直接应用。本文旨在放松对粘性指数的限制，并在热传导指数取任意非负值的情况下建立弱退化MHD系统的整体强解理论。

Method: 在无界区域上考察一维平面可压缩MHD系统，纵向粘性系数设为比容（密度倒数）的幂律函数，热传导系数设为温度的幂律函数。通过先验估计控制比容与温度的时间一致上下界，处理粘性退化带来的奇异性，进而结合连续性论证构造并延拓解，最终证明整体强解的存在唯一性及长时间收敛性。

Result: 对任意固定的非负热传导指数，当粘性正指数充分小时，证明了任意大初值下整体强解的存在唯一性；比容与温度具有与时间无关的上、下界；且对每个容许的粘性指数，解在时间趋于无穷时在空间上一致收敛到平衡态。

Conclusion: 该工作将可压缩MHD系统整体强解的存在性结果推广至粘性退化、热传导指数范围更广的情形，克服了真空附近退化带来的困难，并刻画了真空中解的渐近稳定性，为弱退化耗散系统的整体适定性研究提供了参考。

Abstract: The one-dimensional planar compressible magnetohydrodynamic system is studied on unbounded domains. The longitudinal viscosity obeys a power law of the specific volume, which permits it to degenerate as the density approaches vacuum, and the heat conductivity follows a power law of the temperature. For any fixed non-negative exponent in the heat conductivity term, the existence and uniqueness of global strong solutions are established for arbitrarily large initial data, provided that the positive exponent for viscosity is sufficiently small. The specific volume and temperature possess time-independent upper and lower bounds. Moreover, for each admissible viscosity exponent, the solution converges uniformly in space to the equilibrium state as time tends to infinity.

</details>


### [373] [Derivative Embeddings in Vector-Valued Morrey Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00292)
*Rishad Shahmurov,Veli Shahmurov*

Main category: math.AP

TL;DR: 建立了Banach值演化类在Morrey时间控制下的中间导数理论：若u∈M^{p,λ}(E₀)且u^{(m)}∈M^{p,λ}(E)，则各中间导数u^{(j)}落在弱插值空间M^{p,λ}((E₀,E)_{j/m,∞})中，无需UMD、Fourier型或算子值乘子假设，并给出迹公式、混合嵌入、紧性与Hilbert尺度下的最优指数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典中间导数/插值不等式多在强框架（如UMD、Fourier型、算子值乘子）下证明。本文旨在去除这些假设，把中间导数理论推广到Banach值、时间具有Morrey控制的情形，并处理有限区间、迹、紧性及Hilbert尺度等更精细问题。

Method: 证明基于对D^j的精确有理频率分裂、Peetre K-泛函，以及Morrey空间上的Hardy–Littlewood极大算子。有限区间上构造图-Morrey延拓得到相同嵌入。将导数定理与精确Morrey迹定理结合，得到每个u^{(j)}的精确满射迹公式及混合Hölder/插值嵌入与迹驱动的p到q Morrey增益。

Result: 在无UMD、Fourier型、算子值乘子假设下证明u^{(j)}∈M^{p,λ}((E₀,E)_{j/m,∞})；实直线上估计具尺度最优乘性形式；有限区间同样成立；弱精细指数对任意Banach对最优。得到精确满射迹公式、混合Hölder/插值嵌入、p到q Morrey增益。当E₀紧嵌入E时，在Morrey范数下（插值光滑度任意小损失）与高于导数-迹阈值的时间-Hölder空间中均紧。正自伴Hilbert尺度下，弱插值目标可改进为分数域D(B^{1-j/m})且指数最优。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了无需额外几何/乘子假设的Banach值Morrey中间导数理论，给出尖锐的弱插值目标与最优指数，并导出迹、嵌入、紧性等结果；在Hilbert尺度上进一步将目标改进为分数域并证明其指数尖锐性。

Abstract: We develop an intermediate-derivative theory for Banach-valued evolution classes with Morrey control in time. Let $E_0\hookrightarrow E$ be Banach spaces, $m\ge2$, $1<p<\infty$, and $0\leλ<1$. If $u\in\mathcal M^{p,λ}(E_0)$ and $u^{(m)}\in\mathcal M^{p,λ}(E)$, then every intermediate derivative satisfies \[ u^{(j)}\in\mathcal M^{p,λ}\bigl((E_0,E)_{j/m,\infty}\bigr),\qquad 0<j<m, \] with no UMD, Fourier type, or operator-valued multiplier assumption. The proof is based on an exact rational-frequency splitting of $D^j$, the Peetre $K$-functional, and the Hardy--Littlewood maximal operator on Morrey spaces. On the line the estimate has the scale-sharp multiplicative form. On finite intervals we construct a graph-Morrey extension and obtain the same embedding. The weak fine index is optimal for arbitrary Banach couples. Combining the derivative theorem with the exact Morrey trace theorem yields an exact onto trace formula for every $u^{(j)}$, together with mixed Hölder/interpolation embeddings and a trace-powered $p$-to-$q$ Morrey gain. If $E_0\hookc E$, these embeddings become compact both in the same Morrey norm after an arbitrarily small loss of interpolation smoothness and in time-Hölder spaces above the derivative-trace threshold. For positive selfadjoint Hilbert scales we further improve the weak interpolation target to the fractional domain $D(B^{1-j/m})$ and show that this exponent is sharp.

</details>


### [374] [Resonance expansions and local-energy decay estimates for Dirac operators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02108)
*Zhuo Chen,Michael Melgaard*

Main category: math.AP

TL;DR: 本文研究了三维半经典Dirac算子的共振展开与局域长时间动力学，给出了截断预解式的指数/多项式界、共振展开公式，以及局域能量衰减的显式阈值估计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 作者希望理解半经典Dirac算子在外扰下的长时间行为，特别是能量局域化的传播子在共振集合附近的表现。现有结果对一个精细问题尚未清楚：截断预解式在共振自由薄矩形内的多项式界如何与共振计数、准解析函数演算结合来导出传播子的共振展开，以及局域能量衰减能否给出定量阈值。该文旨在填补这一空白，并进一步刻画全扭曲预解式是否存在统一的 [h log(1/h)]^{-1} 界。

Method: 对光滑Hermitian矩阵值、在紧集外解析的扰动，先证明远离共振集的指数截断预解式界，以及在贴近实轴的薄共振自由矩形内的多项式界；结合共振数的局部 O(h^{-3}) 上界、鸽巢原理选取容许围道、准解析函数演算和Cauchy--Green形变，导出谱局域传播子的共振展开（正能量共振贡献大正时间，负能量共振贡献大负时间）。随后针对非俘获能量窗口中的质量型扰动 βV(x)，利用先前工作建立的共振自由区域与定量FBI变换/逃逸函数论证得到连续截断预解式的多项式界并推出局域能量快速衰减；再通过未扭曲区域的有限时间传播论证改进该多项式估计。引入与空间截断相关的最大正片连接时间 T_χ，证明几何连续预解式估计，并对每个低于共振自由深度常数的固定 M 导出显式局域能量衰减阈值 T_N>T_χ+(N+1)/M。

Result: 得到：(1) 远离共振集的指数截断预解式界与薄共振自由矩形内的多项式界；(2) 谱局域传播子的共振展开，正、负能量共振分别主导正、负大时间行为；(3) 质量型扰动在非俘获能量窗口下，连续截断预解式的多项式界与局域能量快速衰减；(4) 显式局域能量衰减阈值 T_N>T_χ+(N+1)/M；(5) 对全扭曲预解式统一的 [h log(1/h)]^{-1} 界的严格微局域障碍，以及在对数深度处夹层连续预解式的有限飞行时间放大机制。

Conclusion: 该文系统建立了三维半经典Dirac算子的共振展开与局域长时间动力学理论，给出了截断/连续预解式的定量界和能量衰减阈值，并揭示了对数深度下统一预解式界的微局域障碍与放大机制。

Abstract: We study resonance expansions and localised long-time dynamics for three-dimensional semiclassical Dirac operators. For smooth Hermitian matrix-valued perturbations which are analytic outside a compact set, we first obtain exponential cut-off resolvent bounds away from the resonance set and polynomial bounds in thin resonance-free rectangles adjacent to the real axis. Combining these estimates with a local $\Oc(h^{-3})$ upper bound on the number of resonances, a pigeonhole selection of admissible contours, almost-analytic functional calculus, and a Cauchy--Green deformation, we derive resonance expansions for spectrally localised propagators. Positive-energy resonances contribute for large positive times, whereas negative-energy resonances contribute for large negative times. We then specialise to mass-type perturbations $\mbfβV(x)$ in a nontrapping energy window. Using the logarithmic resonance-free region established in our earlier work together with a quantitative FBI-transform/escape-function argument, we obtain a polynomial bound for the continued cut-off resolvent and deduce rapid local-energy decay. We subsequently refine this polynomial estimate by a finite-time propagation argument in the undistorted region. Introducing the maximal positive-sheet connection time $T_χ$ associated with the spatial cutoff, we prove a geometric continued-resolvent estimate and, for every fixed $M$ below the resonance-free depth constant, derive the explicit local-energy decay threshold $T_N>T_χ+(N+1)/M$. The same analysis gives a rigorous microlocal obstruction to a uniform $[h\log(1/h)]^{-1}$ bound for the full distorted resolvent and identifies a finite-flight-time amplification mechanism for the sandwiched continued resolvent at logarithmic depth.

</details>


### [375] [Critical anisotropic $p$-Laplace equations without finite energy: classification and a Schoen-type Harnack inequality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00337)
*Phuong Le*

Main category: math.AP

TL;DR: 该文在非可逆 Minkowski 范数下分类方程 $-\operatorname{div}(H(\nabla u)^{p-1}\nabla H(\nabla u))=u^{p^*-1}$ 的所有非负局部弱解，证明非零解必为各向异性 Sobolev bubble，并给出尺度不变 Schoen 型 Harnack 不等式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决 Antonini–Ciraolo–Gatti 问题 A 的各向异性版本，覆盖完整范围 $1<p<N$；同时去除 Chen–Wu–Yan–Yang 非能量各向异性分类中对 $p$ 的限制，且不假定有限能量、可积性或渐近条件。

Method: 沿用 Zhang 对欧氏 $p$-Laplacian 的策略：有界爆破 profile 的刚性 + 首次接触论证 + Ciraolo–Gatti 积分 bootstrap。新增两项各向异性工具：非临界集上共轭应力张量的分布形式 Bochner 恒等式（仅用 $C^2$ 正则性）；Finsler $p$-调和函数孤立奇点的两项展开及梯度控制。非可逆情形用反射范数表述，并用 Leray–Lions 算子的 Morrey 型估计替代势论输入。

Result: 建立了各向异性方程非负局部弱解的完整分类：一切非零解均为各向异性 Sobolev bubble；证明了尺度不变的 Schoen 型 Harnack 不等式；给出共轭应力张量 Bochner 恒等式与孤立奇点两项展开等新工具。

Conclusion: 该工作将欧氏情形结果推广到非可逆 Minkowski 范数下的完整 $p$ 范围，统一并强化了已有各向异性分类结论，其方法（Bochner 恒等式、奇点展开、Morrey 型估计）对更一般的 Finsler 型临界方程具有独立价值。

Abstract: Let $N\ge 2$ and $1<p<N$. Let $H$ be a possibly non-reversible Minkowski norm on $\mathbb{R}^N$, with $H\in C^2(\mathbb{R}^N\setminus\{0\})$ and $D^2(H^2/2)$ uniformly positive definite away from the origin. We classify all nonnegative local weak solutions $u\in W^{1,p}_{\rm loc}(\mathbb{R}^N)$ of \[ -\operatorname{div}\big(H(\nabla u)^{p-1}\nabla H(\nabla u)\big)=u^{p^*-1},\qquad p^*=\frac{Np}{N-p}, \] without any finite-energy, integrability, or asymptotic assumption. Every nonzero solution is an anisotropic Sobolev bubble. This settles, for the full range $1<p<N$, the anisotropic analogue of Problem A of Antonini--Ciraolo--Gatti, whose Euclidean case was settled by Zhang, and removes the restriction on $p$ in the non-energy anisotropic classification of Chen--Wu--Yan--Yang. We also prove a scale-invariant Schoen-type Harnack inequality for local solutions.
  The proof follows the strategy of Zhang for the Euclidean $p$-Laplacian, combining rigidity of bounded blow-up profiles and a first-contact argument with the integral bootstrap of Ciraolo and Gatti. The anisotropic analysis requires two additional ingredients. First, we establish a Bochner identity for the conjugated stress tensor in distributional form on the noncritical set, using only $C^2$ regularity of $H$. Second, we prove a two-term expansion at isolated singularities of Finsler $p$-harmonic functions, including the gradient control needed by the Pohozaev invariant. For non-reversible anisotropies the argument is formulated with the reflected norm. A Morrey-type estimate proved directly for the relevant Leray--Lions operator replaces the potential-theoretic input used in the Euclidean argument.

</details>


### [376] [Phase transition, sharp asymptotics and symmetry for critical quasilinear Hartree equations beyond $σ=2p$](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00339)
*Phuong Le*

Main category: math.AP

TL;DR: 本文建立临界拟线性Hartree方程在互补区间 $2p<\sigma<N$ 的精确渐近与对称性理论，证明非负有限能量弱解自动局部有界，并揭示由 $\sigma(p-2)+2p$ 符号支配的三种渐近机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有拟线性理论仅覆盖 $\sigma\le 2p$；互补区间 $2p<\sigma<N$ 结构不同，因 $p^*_\sigma<p$ 导致因子化 $u^{p-1}$ 后的有效势在 $u\to0$ 时奇异，原有势论方法失效，亟需新的正则性机制与渐近分类。

Method: 针对互补区间构造适配的拟线性正则性机制，克服势论路径失效的困难，证明有限能量弱解的局部有界性；并通过对 $\sigma(p-2)+2p$ 符号的分类分析，确定三种情形下解的渐近展开与梯度收敛性，进而结合对称性论证。

Result: 在 $p^*_\sigma>1$ 时每个非负有限能量弱解自动局部有界。对正解发现由 $\sigma(p-2)+2p$ 符号控制的尖锐转变：大于零时经典 $p$-调和剖面保持；等于阈值时 $u(x)\simeq |x|^{-\gamma_h}(\log|x|)^{1/(p-p^*_\sigma)}$，$\gamma_h=(N-p)/(p-1)$，且梯度双侧速率匹配；低于阈值时 $u(x)=A_*|x|^{-\gamma_*}+o(|x|^{-\gamma_*})$，$\gamma_*=2(N-p)(\sigma-p)/(p(\sigma-2p))<\gamma_h$，且重标梯度一致收敛到对应径向剖面。

Conclusion: 该工作将临界拟线性Hartree方程理论从 $\sigma\le2p$ 拓展到互补区间 $2p<\sigma<N$，揭示了全新的尖锐渐近三分律；所有三种情形下解关于某点径向对称且沿径向严格递减。

Abstract: We establish the sharp asymptotic and symmetry theory for the critical quasilinear Hartree equation \[ -Δ_pu=\big(|x|^{-σ}*u^{p^*_σ}\big)u^{p^*_σ-1} \quad\text{in }\mathbb R^N, \qquad p^*_σ=\frac{p(2N-σ)}{2(N-p)}, \] in the complementary range $2p<σ<N$, beyond the quasilinear theory previously available for $σ\le2p$ [Math. Ann., 391(2):2653--2708, 2025]. This range is structurally different: $p^*_σ<p$, so the effective potential obtained by factoring out $u^{p-1}$ becomes singular as $u\to0$. Nevertheless, whenever $p^*_σ>1$, every nonnegative finite-energy weak solution is automatically locally bounded. Our proof provides a quasilinear regularity mechanism adapted to this complementary range, where the potential-theoretic route available for $σ\le2p$ breaks down. For positive finite-energy solutions with $p^*_σ>1$ we moreover uncover a sharp transition governed by the sign of $σ(p-2)+2p$. If this quantity is positive, the classical $p$-harmonic profile persists. At the threshold, \[ u(x)\simeq |x|^{-γ_h}(\log|x|)^{1/(p-p^*_σ)}, \qquad γ_h=\frac{N-p}{p-1}, \] with the matching two-sided gradient rate. Below the threshold, \[ u(x)=A_*|x|^{-γ_*}+o(|x|^{-γ_*}), \qquad γ_*=\frac{2(N-p)(σ-p)}{p(σ-2p)}<γ_h, \] and the rescaled gradients converge uniformly to the corresponding radial profile. In all three regimes the solutions are radially symmetric about some point and strictly decreasing in the radial variable.

</details>


### [377] [A Liouville theorem for the real twisted Monge-Ampère equation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00543)
*Joshua Jordan*

Main category: math.AP

TL;DR: 建立了实扭转Monge-Ampère方程在内无一致椭圆假设下的Pogorelov型内部$C^2$估计，并证明具有二次增长的整体分裂凸解的Liouville定理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实扭转Monge-Ampère方程是完全非线性椭圆方程，但既非凹函数也不依赖于Hessian的特征值，导致标准的内部二阶导数估计技术无法直接适用；同时现有刚性定理依赖一致椭圆性假设，限制较强。

Method: 基于Streets与Warren的部分Legendre变换表述，推导相关正定矩阵$W(D^2u)$的微分恒等式，并利用线性代数手段控制最大值原理论证中出现的三阶项，从而在不假设一致椭圆的条件下完成估计。

Result: 在不假设一致椭圆性的情形下获得了实扭转Monge-Ampère方程的Pogorelov型内部$C^2$估计；作为应用，对具有二次增长的整体分裂凸解证明了Liouville定理。

Conclusion: 将Streets与Warren的刚性定理中的一致椭圆性假设替换为适当的二次增长假设，推广了其结论。

Abstract: We establish a Pogorelov type interior $C^2$ estimate for the real twisted Monge-Ampere equation without assuming uniform ellipticity. This equation is fully nonlinear and elliptic, but is neither concave nor a function of the eigenvalues of the Hessian, so the standard techniques for interior second-derivative estimates do not directly apply. Building on the partial Legendre transform formulation of Streets and Warren, we derive a differential identity for the associated positive-definite matrix $W(D^2u)$ and use some linear algebra to control the third-order terms arising in the maximum principle argument. As an application, we prove a Liouville theorem for entire split convex solutions with quadratic growth, extending the rigidity theorem of Streets and Warren by replacing their uniform ellipticity hypothesis with suitable quadratic growth assumptions.

</details>


### [378] [Ill-posedness in the critical Sobolev space for the hyperelastic rod equation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00594)
*Dan-Andrei Geba*

Main category: math.AP

TL;DR: 该文是Camassa-Holm型方程临界Sobolev空间不适定性系列的第三篇，证明超弹性杆方程在临界正则性 $H^{3/2}(\mathbb R)$ 处不适定，且不适定性质随参数 $\gamma$ 的不同而分两类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 补齐超弹性杆方程在临界Sobolev正则性 $H^{3/2}$ 处的不适定性理论：此前已知 $s>3/2$ 局部适定，$1<s<3/2$ 有范数膨胀结果，但临界端点 $s=3/2$ 的情形尚空缺。

Method: 在临界Sobolev空间 $H^{3/2}(\mathbb R)$ 中，通过构造特殊的初值（光滑小初值或小 $H^{3/2}$ 范数初值），分别针对参数区间 $0<\gamma\leq3$ 与 $\gamma<0$ 或 $\gamma>3$ 进行显式爆破/范数膨胀构造。

Result: 当 $0<\gamma\leq3$：构造出任意小的光滑初值，其解发生有限时间爆破，且最大生命期随初值尺度趋于零而趋于零；当 $\gamma<0$ 或 $\gamma>3$：构造出任意小 $H^{3/2}$ 初值，其解的 $H^{3/2}$ 范数在任意短时间内变得任意大。

Conclusion: 超弹性杆方程在临界正则性 $H^{3/2}(\mathbb R)$ 处是不适定的，其不适定机制依赖于参数 $\gamma$：低 $\gamma$ 区间表现为有限时间爆破，其余区间表现为瞬时范数膨胀。

Abstract: This article is the third in a series investigating ill-posedness in critical Sobolev spaces for Camassa-Holm-type equations. Following results for the $b$-Novikov and Fokas-Olver-Rosenau-Qiao equations, we study the hyperelastic rod equation at the critical Sobolev regularity $H^{3/2}(\mathbb R)$. We prove ill-posedness at this endpoint, complementing the local well-posedness theory in $H^s(\mathbb R)$ for $s>3/2$ and the recently established norm-inflation result for $1<s<3/2$.
  The nature of the critical ill-posedness depends on the parameter $γ$. For $0<γ\leq3$, we construct arbitrarily small smooth initial data whose corresponding solutions develop finite-time blow-up, with the maximal lifespan tending to zero with the size of the initial data. For $γ<0$ or $γ>3$, we construct solutions with arbitrarily small $H^{3/2}$ initial data whose $H^{3/2}$ norm becomes arbitrarily large in arbitrarily short time.

</details>


### [379] [Optimal multipolar Lp-Hardy inequalities: ground states, criticality, and variational thresholds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00652)
*Yongyang Jin,Shoufeng Shen,Li Tang*

Main category: math.AP

TL;DR: 研究了真多极 Lp-Hardy 权重的基态、临界性与变分紧致性之间的关系，给出跨极点的基态表示与全势参数分类，并刻画了最优截断系数及紧致性阈值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对一类真多极 Lp-Hardy 权重，需要理解基态表示、临界性判据与变分紧致性之间的内在联系，并区分有限能量达到与非达到临界性，同时刻画去掉几何交互项后第二变分问题的最优系数行为。

Method: 利用适用于所有极点的基态表示对全势进行临界/次临界参数分类；构造去掉几何交互项的第二变分问题；结合零序列刚性与严格极点容量方法，以及在底层向量场零点集上的局部加权紧致性论证。

Result: 证明了低于阈值时的严格间隙可导出归一化极小化序列的强紧致性、正极值元与最优重标算子的临界性；1<p<2 时间隙在全势临界集上成立且最优截断系数严格小于 1，p>2 时在全势达到区域严格大于 1；在二次达到区域内固定参数下，最优值随 p→2 收敛到 1，两侧均具达到性与临界性。

Conclusion: 建立了多极 Lp-Hardy 框架下基态、临界性与变分紧致性的统一刻画，明确了最优截断系数随 p 的相变行为及 p→2 的极限连续性。

Abstract: We study the relation between ground states, criticality, and variational compactness for a family of genuinely multipolar Lp-Hardy weights, 1 < p < n. A ground-state representation valid across the poles gives a complete classification of the full potential into critical and subcritical parameter regions and distinguishes finite-energy attainment from non-attained criticality. Removing a geometric interaction term leads to a second variational problem, whose optimal coefficient is controlled by concentration at the poles and at infinity. We prove that a strict gap below the resulting threshold yields strong compactness of normalized minimizing sequences, a positive extremizer, and criticality of the optimally rescaled operator. For 1 < p < 2, this gap holds throughout the full-potential critical set and the optimal truncated coefficient is strictly below 1; for p >2, the coefficient is strictly above 1 in the full-potential attainment region. At fixed parameters strictly inside the quadratic attained region, the optimal value converges to 1 as p tending to 2, with attainment and criticality on both sides. The proofs combine null sequence rigidity and strict-pole capacity with local weighted compactness across the zero set of the underlying vector field.

</details>


### [380] [Global weak varifold solutions to Navier-Stokes/Mean Curvature Flow system](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00732)
*Andrea Poiatti*

Main category: math.AP

TL;DR: 本文引入Navier-Stokes/平均曲率流系统的变分流（varifold）弱解新概念，首次证明其无条件整体存在性，并证明经典解在该弱解类中唯一。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Navier-Stokes/平均曲率流系统描述不可压、黏性、不相溶两相流体，界面演化由对流平均曲率流控制并与含表面张力的两相Navier-Stokes方程耦合，可刻画干泡沫动力学及非消失迁移率下Navier-Stokes/Allen-Cahn系统的尖锐界面极限。然而，任意类型弱解的整体存在性长期是未解决的难题。

Method: 在二维和三维空间引入基于De Giorgi尖锐能量耗散原理的变分流（varifold）弱解新概念；并采用相对熵（relative entropy）方法。

Result: 首次证明该类变分流弱解的无条件整体存在性；并证明任意经典解在该弱变分流解类中唯一。

Conclusion: 该工作通过变分流框架与尖锐能量耗散原理，突破了该耦合系统弱解整体存在性的长期难题，并借助相对熵方法确立了弱解类中经典解的唯一性。

Abstract: The Navier-Stokes/Mean Curvature Flow system describes a two-phase flow of incompressible, viscous and immiscible fluids separated by a sharp interface, whose evolution is governed by a convective mean curvature flow equation, coupled to a two-phase Navier-Stokes equation accounting for surface tension. Among others, this model describes the dynamics of dry foams and it also arises as a sharp interface limit of Navier-Stokes/Allen-Cahn systems with non-vanishing mobility. Despite this wide range of applications, global-in-time existence of any kind of weak solutions remains a challenging open problem. In this work, we introduce a novel notion of varifold weak solution in two and three ambient dimensions, based on a sharp energy dissipation principle à la De Giorgi, and we show for the first time the unconditional global-in-time existence of such a weak solution. We also show, by means of a relative entropy approach, that any classical solution to the Navier-Stokes/Mean Curvature Flow system is unique in the class of our new weak varifold solutions.

</details>


### [381] [An explicit formula for the solution of the Benjamin-Ono equation and its applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00770)
*Louise Gassot,Patrick Gérard,Peter D. Miller*

Main category: math.AP

TL;DR: 本文综述Benjamin-Ono方程Cauchy问题解的显式公式，并利用该公式（及有理初值下的简化形式）简洁解释小色散与长时间极限下的渐近行为，证明有理初值假设下soliton resolution的逐点收敛及具体衰减率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Benjamin-Ono方程是深水内波的重要长波渐近模型，已有通过显式解公式得到的理论进展，但该公式尚未广泛进入应用数学领域；作者希望系统描述并推广该公式，使其可被应用数学读者使用，同时利用该公式统一且简洁地理解渐近行为。

Method: 围绕Cauchy问题解的显式公式进行综述：完整描述该公式并给出简单例子；说明限制到有理初值时公式如何进一步简化；利用公式及其有理限制分析小色散极限与长时间极限下的渐近行为；在长时间渐近中，针对有理初值证明与soliton resolution相关的新结果，给出逐点收敛及具体衰减率。论文前半部分为独立综述与使用指南，后半部分附录包含新结果的完整证明。

Result: 给出Cauchy问题解显式公式的完整描述与示例；展示有理初值下公式的简化；以简洁方式详细解释小色散和长时间极限下的解渐近行为；在有理初值假设下证明soliton resolution的逐点收敛并给出具体衰减率。

Conclusion: 该文既作为Benjamin-Ono方程显式解公式的独立综述与使用指南，又通过新结果深化了长时间渐近与soliton resolution的理论；显式公式及其有理限制为理解渐近行为提供了统一而简洁的框架，并使其更贴近应用数学。

Abstract: We summarize recent developments in the theory of the Benjamin-Ono equation, a well-known long-wave asymptotic model for internal waves in deep water, focusing on results obtained by means of an explicit formula for the solution of the Cauchy problem in terms of given initial data. We give a full description of this formula, and provide simple examples, with the aim of bringing it into the realm of applied mathematics. We also show how the formula simplifies further upon restriction to rational initial data. We then show how the formula and its rational restriction explain in great detail, and in a strikingly simple fashion, the asymptotic behavior of solutions of the Benjamin-Ono equation in the small-dispersion and long-time limits. In the setting of long-time asymptotics, we prove some new results related to soliton resolution yielding pointwise convergence with a concrete decay rate under the assumption of rational initial data. The first half of the paper is a stand-alone general survey and user's guide, while the appendices constituting the second half are intended for readers who want to explore the topics in greater depth, and it includes the proofs of our new results.

</details>


### [382] [Uniqueness and nonuniqueness in the disjoint data inverse problem: a sharp spectral threshold](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00871)
*Lauri Ylinen*

Main category: math.AP

TL;DR: 该论文研究从波观测反演连通闭黎曼流形的逆问题，证明在亚临界谱下界条件下唯一性成立（至等距），且θ=1/2为临界端点并构造反例。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 波观测反问题中源集S与接收集R可相距正距离，需探讨在何种谱条件下能唯一确定流形（至等距），并厘清唯一性成立的临界阈值。

Method: 定义谱下界条件：对任意特征函数φ，有‖φ|_R‖_{L²(R)} ≥ ce^{-Cλ^θ}‖φ‖_{L²(M)}，θ∈[0,1/2)。在此类流形上证明波观测唯一性；若该界在S上亦成立，则推广至全体连通闭流形；并通过构造非等距流形对给出θ=1/2端点的反例。

Result: 在满足亚临界谱下界（θ∈[0,1/2)）的流形类中，波观测唯一确定流形至等距；若S上亦有同型界，则唯一性在全体连通闭流形中成立。由谱不等式该界总以θ=1/2成立，但此端点唯一性失效：对每个n≥2，存在产生相同波观测的非等距连通闭n维黎曼流形对。

Conclusion: 唯一性在亚临界谱下界下成立，θ=1/2为尖锐临界端点，端点处唯一性因构造的反例而失败，说明该阈值不可改进。

Abstract: We study the inverse problem of determining a connected, closed Riemannian manifold of dimension at least two from wave observations. The sources are supported in an open set $S$, and the resulting waves are observed on an open receiver set $R$, which may be at a positive distance from $S$. We prove uniqueness up to isometry within the class of manifolds that satisfy a subcritical spectral lower bound: $\|φ|_R\|_{L^2(R)} \ge ce^{-Cλ^θ}\|φ\|_{L^2(M)}$ for every eigenfunction $φ$, where $λ$ is the corresponding eigenvalue, $θ\in[0,1/2)$, and the constants $c,C>0$ do not depend on $φ$. If a bound of this type holds also on $S$, then uniqueness holds within the class of all connected, closed manifolds. By the spectral inequality, the bound always holds with $θ=1/2$. Uniqueness nevertheless fails at this endpoint: in every dimension $n\ge 2$, we construct a pair of nonisometric connected, closed Riemannian $n$-manifolds that produce identical wave observations.

</details>


### [383] [The focusing Calogero--Moser derivative nonlinear Schrödinger equation in the Hardy--Zhidkov space: explicit flow formula and dark multi-solitons](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00955)
*Ruoci Sun*

Main category: math.AP

TL;DR: 本文研究非零边界条件下聚焦型Calogero--Moser导数非线性Schrödinger（CMdNLS）方程，证明其存在一类由Lax算子点谱谱隙[-1,0]和Hardy空间结构驱动的暗多孤子解，并建立Hardy--Zhidkov空间显式解公式、暗N-孤子集不变性、作用-角变量及完全可积性，导出极点满足复化Calogero--Moser系统的逆谱公式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典三次非线性Schrödinger方程中聚焦非线性仅在零背景上支持亮孤子，本文旨在揭示聚焦CMdNLS方程在非零背景条件下可存在丰富的暗多孤子解，突破这一传统认知，并解决相关可积性刻画问题。

Method: 基于Lax--Beurling移位半群与Toeplitz算子之间的新交换子估计，采用半群方法在Hardy--Zhidkov空间Z^2_+中建立一般解的显式公式，规避无界生成元与时间导数的不对易性且无需加权假设；通过谱条件等价性刻画暗多孤子势，结合生成泛函守恒证明暗N-孤子集U_N的流不变性，并构造作用-角变量。

Result: 获得三项主要结果：Hardy--Zhidkov空间中一般解的显式公式；暗多孤子势的代数定义等价于Lax算子两个谱条件，并证明U_N在CMdNLS流下不变；构造U_N上的作用-角变量，确立该方程在U_N上的完全可积性。进一步导出逆谱公式，得到长时渐近与一致Sobolev估计。

Conclusion: 聚焦CMdNLS方程在非零背景上支持暗多孤子解，其存在由Lax算子点谱谱隙[-1,0]及Hardy空间结构决定；暗多孤子解的极点满足复化Calogero--Moser系统，方程在暗N-孤子集上完全可积。

Abstract: This paper studies the focusing Calogero--Moser derivative nonlinear Schrödinger (CMdNLS) equation under the nonzero boundary condition \(|u(t,x)|\to 1\) as \(|x|\to+\infty\). In sharp contrast to the classical paradigm for the cubic nonlinear Schrödinger equation, namely that focusing nonlinearities support only bright solitons on a zero background, we show that the focusing CMdNLS equation admits a rich family of \emph{dark multi-soliton} solutions on a nonzero background, whose existence is driven by a spectral gap \([-1,0]\) in the point spectrum of the Lax operator, together with the Hardy space structure.
  The main results are threefold. First, we establish an explicit formula for general solutions in the Hardy--Zhidkov space \(\mathcal Z^2_+\), via a \emph{semigroup method} based on new commutator estimates between the Lax--Beurling shift semigroup and Toeplitz operators. This approach circumvents the non-commutativity of the unbounded generator with the time derivative and requires no weighted hypothesis on solutions or on the domain of validity of commutator formulas. Second, the algebraic definition of dark multi-soliton potentials is shown to be equivalent to two spectral conditions on the Lax operator. Together with the conservation of a generating functional, this yields the invariance of the dark \(N\)-soliton set \(\mathcal U_N\) under the CMdNLS flow. Third, the action-angle variables on \(\mathcal U_N\) are constructed, which establishes the complete integrability of the focusing CMdNLS equation on \(\mathcal U_N\).
  Combining these results, we obtain an inverse spectral formula, from which it follows that the poles of dark multi-soliton solutions satisfy a complexified Calogero--Moser system. Long time asymptotics and uniform Sobolev estimates are also derived.

</details>


### [384] [Emergence of cuspons through wave breaking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01109)
*Yunjoo Kim,Bongsuk Kwon*

Main category: math.AP

TL;DR: 该论文研究Camassa–Holm方程中cuspon通过波破裂的产生机制：对一大类光滑初值，首次奇异性发生在唯一点并具有尖锐局部Hölder正则性C^{3/5}；作者构造穿越奇异时刻的Lagrangian流延拓并重建保守Eulerian弱解，证明首次奇异性并非简单持续，而是立即分叉为一对反对称cuspon–cuspon，各自具有C^{2/3}正则性与相反单侧斜率，两支分离且其间剖面局部单调性反转。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统上cuspon多通过奇异行波假设被"强加"到解中，缺乏从光滑初值动态产生的机制。本文旨在说明cuspon可以经由波破裂从光滑初值中自然涌现，并刻画破裂点处精细的奇异几何结构。

Method: 以Camassa–Holm方程为模型，引入扩展逆斜率变量，该变量在波破裂时仍保持正则。证明首次奇异时刻该变量具有非退化二次零点，随后立即分裂为两个单零点。借助Lagrangian流映射的退化性，将二次破裂几何转换为C^{3/5}剖面，将破裂后的单零点几何转换为C^{2/3} cuspon剖面；并用广义Hunter–Saxton族给出同一机制的显式实现。

Result: 首次奇异性在唯一点发生且尖锐Hölder指数为C^{3/5}；破裂后立即分叉为反对称cuspon–cuspon对，各自正则性为C^{2/3}，两侧斜率方向相反；两支奇异分支从原破裂点分离，其间剖面局部单调性反转。广义Hunter–Saxton族可显式追踪奇异分支的相互作用与湮灭。

Conclusion: 反cuspon–cuspon对可通过波破裂从光滑初值动态涌现，而无需借助奇异行波假设；扩展逆斜率变量与Lagrangian流退化为理解波破裂及cuspon形成提供了统一机制。

Abstract: We study the emergence of cuspons through wave breaking, with the Camassa--Holm equation as a principal model. For a broad open class of smooth initial data, the first singularity occurs at a unique point and has the sharp local Hölder regularity \(C^{3/5}\). We construct a continuation of the Lagrangian flow through this singular time and reconstruct from it a conservative Eulerian weak solution. We show that the first singularity does not simply persist after breaking; instead, it bifurcates immediately into an anticuspon--cuspon pair, each having the sharp local Hölder regularity \(C^{2/3}\), with opposite one-sided slope orientations. The two singular branches move apart from the original breaking point, and the portion of the profile between them reverses its local monotonicity. The proof is based on an extended inverse-slope variable that remains regular through wave breaking. At the first singular time, this variable has a nondegenerate quadratic zero, which splits immediately afterward into two simple zeros. The corresponding degeneracy of the Lagrangian flow map converts the quadratic first-breaking geometry into the \(C^{3/5}\) profile and the post-breaking simple-zero geometry into the \(C^{2/3}\) cuspon profiles. The generalized Hunter--Saxton family provides an explicit realization of the same Lagrangian mechanism and also allows us to track the subsequent interaction and annihilation of the singular branches. Thus an anticuspon--cuspon pair emerges dynamically from smooth initial data through wave breaking, rather than being imposed through a singular traveling-wave ansatz.

</details>


### [385] [Instantaneous Exponential Ill-posedness of the BGK Model in a Half-Space with Inflow Boundary Conditions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.01225)
*Donghyun Lee,Sungbin Park,Sung-jun Son,Seok-Bae Yun*

Main category: math.AP

TL;DR: 本文研究半空间、真空初值下BGK模型与Boltzmann方程的边界驱动行为，构造了会瞬间逃离指数加权空间的BGK解，并对比了两类方程在边界流入情形下的结构差异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将全空间的相关分析推广到半空间边界驱动设定，揭示局部Maxwellian松弛与Boltzmann碰撞算子在边界流入与真空初值下的结构性差异。

Method: 对切向指数权 $e^{\alpha|v_h|^\beta}$ 下的小流入数据，结合密度、体速度、温度的奇异尺度精细估计与时间依赖各向异性空间中的不动点论证构造局部BGK解；并用各向同性指数权 $e^{\alpha|v|^\beta}$ 建立截断Boltzmann方程的局部存在唯一性。

Result: 对任意 $1\leq\beta\leq2$、$\alpha>0$，构造出唯一局部时间BGK解：其流入数据在权重 $e^{\alpha|v_h|^\beta}$ 下范数任意小，但在任意更弱权重 $e^{\alpha'|v_h|^\beta}$（$0<\alpha'\leq\alpha$）及任意正存在时间下范数无穷，说明解瞬间离开与流入数据对应的指数加权空间；附录进一步表明所需宏观稳定性即使对Maxwellian流入数据也可能失效，可通过削弱法向速度衰减恢复。

Conclusion: 边界流入与真空初值下，局部Maxwellian松弛与Boltzmann碰撞算子存在结构性差异；指数权刻画对半空间分析至关重要，研究将全空间结果拓展至半空间。

Abstract: In this paper, we study boundary-driven behavior of the BGK model and the Boltzmann equation in a half-space with vacuum initial data. For any $1\leqβ\leq2$ and $α>0$, we construct a unique local-in-time BGK solution whose inflow boundary data have an arbitrarily small norm with the tangential exponential weight $e^{α|v_h|^β}$, but whose norm with weight $e^{α'|v_h|^β}$ is infinite for every $0<α'\leqα$ and every positive time of existence, where $v=(v_h,v_z)\in\mathbb{R}^n$ and $v_h\in\mathbb{R}^{n-1}$ denotes the tangential velocity. Thus, this BGK solution instantaneously leaves the exponentially weighted spaces associated with the inflow data, even when the exponential weight is weakened.
